Study_Title: A HIPAA-Compliant Architecture for Agentic Clinical AI Systems
Threat_Attacker_Model: Unauthorized clinical roles and prompt-injection attackers attempting to access or exfiltrate Protected Health Information (PHI) across pre-inference and post-inference LLM agent stages.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) policy engine, hybrid regex and BERT-based pre/post-inference PHI sanitization pipeline with anchor-based placeholder mapping, and immutable compliance audit trails.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Pre-Inference Sanitization Middleware, ABAC Policy Decision Point, and Post-Inference Redaction & Audit Gateway
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Policy-consistent PHI exposure control, defense-in-depth redaction of HIPAA Safe Harbor identifiers (§164.514(b)(2)), and 100% blocking of unauthorized user requests across 107,800 MIMIC-IV evaluation runs.
Trust_Assumptions: Trusted ABAC policy engine, secure anchor-to-PHI mapping store, and English-language clinical workflow inputs.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: Evaluated across 107,800 runs on MIMIC-IV discharge summaries: O(1) prompt construction reduces computational overhead by 77.3%; achieves 100% ABAC blocking for unauthorized users and 1.00 unweighted F1 (zero leaks) for restricted clinical roles (PDF p. 1, 5, 7–8).
Exposed_Security_Function: ABAC role-attribute authorization, pre/post-inference PHI redaction, and immutable compliance audit logging
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Relies on English-centric NER/BERT models and exhibits residual susceptibility to cross-lingual translation attacks (Section 6, p. 9); non-cryptographic sanitization relies on trusted middleware isolation.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract (107,800 runs on MIMIC-IV); pp. 3–6 Section 4 (ABAC, Pre/Post-Inference Sanitization, Audit Logging, Fig. 3); pp. 7–8 Section 5 (77.3% computational overhead reduction, 100% ABAC success rate, F1=1.00); p. 9 Section 6 (Translation attack limitation).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Arsitektur AI klinis agenik yang patuh HIPAA menegakkan kontrol akses ABAC, sanitasi pra/pasca-inferensi hibrida (regex + BERT), dan jejak audit imutabel pada 107.800 eksekusi MIMIC-IV dengan penurunan overhead komputasi 77,3% dan tingkat keberhasilan ABAC 100%.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi terkontrol pada 107.800 run ringkasan pasien MIMIC-IV lintas peran klinis dan pengujian stres injeksi prompt (10 kelas kerentanan).
Protected_Object: Protected Health Information (PHI) identifiers in unstructured EHR clinical notes and agent outputs
Composition_Evidence: Mengomposisikan gerbang ABAC dan sanitasi pra-inferensi (B1), rekonstruksi pasca-inferensi (B3), serta pencatatan jejak audit kepatuhan imutabel (B4).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A ini merancang arsitektur pertahanan berlapis (B1;B3;B4) untuk agen klinis. Diberi kode DG;AD karena penulis secara eksplisit mendokumentasikan kerentanan terhadap serangan translasi multibahasa pada Section 6 p. 9 (DG) serta mengasumsikan middleware ABAC dan tabel pemetaan placeholder berjalan pada domain tepercaya (AD).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan penghematan overhead 77,3% pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: AAE: A Real-Time Monitoring and Auditing System for AI Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Opaque autonomous agent execution, prompt-induced anomalous tool invocations, and unmonitored token/resource exhaustion in long-running agent deployments.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Real-time multi-dimensional observability and auditing pipeline (AAE / AI Agent Eye) with rule-based security risk scoring, real-time ETL processing, and span/trace correlation.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Post-execution telemetry collector, real-time ETL processor, and audit analysis engine on OpenClaw instance
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Real-time behavioral traceability, token cost transparency, and rule-based anomaly/security risk identification across agent execution spans.
Trust_Assumptions: Underlying OpenClaw host, telemetry hooks, and local log storage are uncompromised and faithfully emit execution spans (no cryptographic log signing or tamper-evident hashing).
Performance_Overhead_Reported: Evaluated on a production-like OpenClaw deployment (Section 3.1, p. 3): Section 3.5 (p. 5, Fig. 7) reports that under continuous monitoring workloads CPU usage stays below 50% on average while memory consumption remains stable with low query latency; specific <3.5% CPU / <250 MB figures from pilot template were corrected against PDF p. 5.
Exposed_Security_Function: Real-time execution trace correlation, security indicator rule evaluation, and token-cost auditing
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Provides passive observability and rule-based risk scoring without cryptographic tamper-evidence (no hash-chaining or digital signatures) or active pre-execution blocking; evaluated on a single production-like OpenClaw instance.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan audit langsung PDF ter-pin. PDF p. 1 Abstract (production-like OpenClaw instance); pp. 2–3 Section 2 (AAE Architecture, Fig. 1, Detection Rules & Risk Scoring); pp. 3–5 Section 3.1–3.5 (Security/Cost/Behavioral Analysis, Fig. 2–7, CPU stays below 50% on average and memory remains stable).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: AAE (AI Agent Eye) menyediakan pemantauan dan audit waktu nyata untuk agen AI melalui korelasi trace eksekusi, metrik biaya token, dan aturan skor risiko keamanan pada instans OpenClaw mirip-produksi.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Diaudit ulang oleh Reviewer 2 dari PDF SCR-0347_ACM-S-0006.pdf (6 hlm.): evaluasi observasi kontinu pada instans OpenClaw mirip-produksi (Section 3, pp. 3–5).
Protected_Object: Agent execution traces, tool invocation logs, token consumption metrics, and security risk indicators
Composition_Evidence: Mengintegrasikan pengumpulan span eksekusi, skor risiko berbasis aturan, dan analitik biaya pada B4, tanpa pengikatan kriptografis ke batas pra-eksekusi B3.
Coding_Rationale: Audit & Penyempurnaan Reviewer 2 atas draf pilot CLM-0022: (1) PDF p. 1 & Sec. 3.1 secara eksplisit menyebut 'a production-like OpenClaw instance', sehingga Implementation_Maturity dikalibrasi dari PRODUCTION_DEPLOYED menjadi DEPLOYMENT_LIKE_EVALUATION; (2) angka template awal ('CPU <3.5%, memory <250 MB') tidak ditemukan di PDF dan dikoreksi sesuai Section 3.5 p. 5 ('CPU usage stays below 50% on average, while memory consumption remains stable'); (3) kode limitasi diperkuat menjadi AD;UG karena ketiadaan proteksi kriptografis log (AD) dan evaluasi terbatas pada satu instans OpenClaw (UG).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas koreksi metrik Section 3.5 p. 5 dan kalibrasi DEPLOYMENT_LIKE_EVALUATION.

Study_Title: Access Controlled Website Interaction for Agentic AI with Delegated Critical Tasks
Threat_Attacker_Model: Untrusted or low-trust AI agents attempting unauthorized website actions, privilege escalation, or replay of delegated session credentials when performing critical tasks on behalf of users.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Extended open-source Auth service issuing trust-tiered symmetric session keys (AES-128-CBC with SHA-256 MAC) bound to ExpectedOwnerGroups, MaxNumOwners, and trust-dependent Relative Validity (2 hours for HighTrust, 1 hour for MediumTrust, 5 minutes for LowTrust).
Enforcement_Point_Location: Authorization Service (Auth) Session Key Issuance Endpoint and Access-Controlled Website Verification Gateway
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Authenticated access delegation and trust-level-scoped session authorization: valid agents achieve 100% authentication/task success while unauthorized or group-mismatched agents achieve 0% success across evaluated trust tiers (Figure 5, p. 4).
Trust_Assumptions: Centralized Auth server is honest and securely distributes session keys; user accurately assigns agent trust groups (High/Medium/Low); symmetric keys remain confidential to authorized owners.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 4 Section 3 & Figure 5: end-to-end delegated-access task latency is 127–140 seconds for authorized High/Medium/Low-trust agents (dominated by LLM web interaction steps) versus 98.7 seconds for rejected unauthorized requests; 100% authorized success rate and 0% unauthorized success rate.
Exposed_Security_Function: Trust-tiered session key generation, ExpectedOwnerGroups verification, and AES128CBC:SHA256 authenticated website access
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Relies on manual user assignment of agent trust levels and static symmetric session keys (AES128CBC:SHA256) without fine-grained per-action semantic verification once a session key is granted; evaluated on a single prototype website.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 2 Section 2.1 & Figures 1–2 (SessionKeyId workflow, AES128CBC:SHA256, Relative Validity 2h/1h/5min); pp. 3–4 Section 3, Table 1 & Figure 5 (100% valid agent success, 0% unauthorized success, 127–140 s authorized e2e latency vs 98.7 s rejected).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Sistem delegasi akses berbasis tingkat kepercayaan menggunakan kunci sesi kriptografis (AES128CBC:SHA256) dengan masa berlaku adaptif (5 menit hingga 2 jam) dan verifikasi grup pemilik untuk mengamankan interaksi agen AI pada situs web kritis.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Purwarupa layanan Auth dan situs web terkontrol dengan evaluasi agen High/Medium/Low-trust dan agen tidak sah (Table 1, Figure 5, pp. 3–4).
Protected_Object: Delegated session keys (SessionKey/SessionKeyId) and critical website operations
Composition_Evidence: Mengikat delegasi pengguna (B1) ke penerbitan kunci sesi berbasis grup kepercayaan (B2) dan verifikasi bukti autentikasi saat agen mengakses situs web (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream M_AND_A ini mengimplementasikan spesifikasi kriptografis eksplisit `AES128CBC:SHA256` dengan masa hidup token berjenjang (Figure 2, p. 2). Diberi kode STAGE_0_PRE_QUANTUM_ONLY karena menggunakan primitif klasik eksplisit tanpa pembahasan PQC, serta AD;UG karena asumsi klasifikasi trust statis oleh pengguna (AD) dan pengujian terbatas pada satu situs web purwarupa (UG).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan latensi Figure 5 (127–140 s vs 98,7 s) pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: AgentBound: Securing Execution Boundaries of AI Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Malicious, compromised, or vulnerable MCP servers and indirect prompt injections attempting unauthorized filesystem access, network exfiltration, command execution, or rug-pull privilege escalation on the host system.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Declarative least-privilege access control manifest (AgentManifest) with automated source-code manifest generator (AgentManifestGen) and Docker/OS-level runtime Policy Enforcement Engine.
Enforcement_Point_Location: MCP Client-Server Runtime Policy Enforcement Proxy and Container Sandbox Boundary
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Least-privilege containment of MCP server execution capabilities across 16 capability types (filesystem, network, subprocess, environment), blocking 100% of out-of-policy MCP attacks while automatically synthesizing manifests with 80.9% exact match (96.5% capability-level accuracy).
Trust_Assumptions: Host OS kernel and Docker container runtime are uncompromised; user or developer reviews/approves the declarative AgentManifest; application-level logic flaws inside allowed capability scopes (e.g., SQLi within an allowed DB) remain out of scope.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 3, 13–18 (Sections 4.1–4.3): policy enforcement engine adds an average runtime latency overhead of only 0.6 ms per MCP call; AgentManifestGen achieves 80.9% exact manifest accuracy (96.5% capability-level accuracy, 0.94 precision, 0.96 recall across 48 MCP servers) at a total LLM API cost of $99.25 across 298 MCP servers.
Exposed_Security_Function: Declarative MCP capability manifest generation (AgentManifestGen) and runtime policy enforcement proxy
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Cannot prevent attacks that operate strictly within legitimately granted static capabilities (e.g., SQL injection on an authorized database or exfiltration to an allowed domain, Section 4.2 p. 18); relies on Docker container isolation integrity (p. 19).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 3 Section 1 (80.9% manifest accuracy, 0.6 ms average enforcement overhead); pp. 6–11 Section 3 (AgentBound Framework, Table 1); pp. 12–18 Section 4 (298 MCP servers dataset, 48 ground-truth servers, 96.5% accuracy, $99.25 cost, attack evaluation Fig. 6).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: AgentBound mengamankan batas eksekusi server MCP melalui kebijakan akses deklaratif bergaya izin Android (AgentManifest) dan mesin penegakan kebijakan berbasis kontainer dengan rata-rata overhead hanya 0,6 ms serta akurasi pembuatan manifes otomatis 80,9% (akurasi tingkat kapabilitas 96,5%).
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi kelengkapan pada 298 server MCP, evaluasi akurasi otomatis pada 48 server MCP berlabel manual, evaluasi pertahanan terhadap skenario serangan MCP, dan pengukuran overhead runtime.
Protected_Object: Host filesystem, network interfaces, environment variables, and subprocess execution boundaries of MCP servers
Composition_Evidence: Menghubungkan ekstraksi manifes izin statis dari kode sumber MCP dengan penegakan isolasi kontainer saat pemanggilan alat pada B3.
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (FSE'26) ini memberikan evaluasi terukur yang sangat kuat untuk pengamanan batas eksekusi MCP (B3) dengan overhead rata-rata 0,6 ms. Diberi kode AD karena penulis secara eksplisit menyatakan bahwa serangan di dalam kapabilitas yang diizinkan (mis. SQLi internal) dan eksploitasi kernel/Docker berada di luar cakupan (pp. 18–19). Studi ini juga didekomposisi menjadi klaim sekunder (CLM-E01-004B) untuk otomatisasi sintesis kebijakan AgentManifestGen.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan overhead 0,6 ms pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: AgentBound: Securing Execution Boundaries of AI Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Over-privileged or undocumented MCP server distributions lacking explicit capability manifests ('trust-by-default' deployment).
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Automated LLM-assisted static source-code capability extractor (AgentManifestGen) synthesizing declarative AgentManifest permission policies across 16 capability categories.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Pre-Deployment / Onboarding MCP Server Source-Code Policy Generator (AgentManifestGen)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Automatically synthesizes declarative least-privilege AgentManifest policies from MCP server source code with 80.9% exact manifest accuracy and 96.5% capability-level accuracy (0.94 precision, 0.96 recall across 48 ground-truth MCP servers).
Trust_Assumptions: MCP server source code analyzed during manifest generation matches the deployed code; developers review generated manifests for the remaining ~3.5% capability discrepancies.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 1, 13–15 (Section 4.1): evaluated across 298 MCP servers (and 48 manually labeled ground-truth servers), achieving 80.9% exact manifest match (28/48 exact, 14/48 off by 1 capability), 96.5% overall capability accuracy (0.94 precision, 0.96 recall), at a total LLM API cost of $99.25.
Exposed_Security_Function: Automated source-to-manifest capability synthesis (AgentManifestGen)
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: 20 of 48 generated manifests differed by 1–3 capabilities from human ground truth (80.9% exact match, p. 14–15), requiring human developer verification to avoid over- or under-privileging.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract (80.9% manifest accuracy); pp. 10–11 Section 3.3 (AgentManifestGen prompt & AST pipeline); pp. 12–15 Section 4.1 & Figures 3–5 (298 MCP servers, 48 ground-truth comparison: 96.5% overall accuracy, 0.94 precision, 0.96 recall, $99.25 API cost).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: AgentManifestGen mengekstrak kebijakan kontrol akses deklaratif secara otomatis dari kode sumber server MCP dengan akurasi manifes eksak 80,9% dan akurasi tingkat kapabilitas 96,5% (presisi 0,94 dan recall 0,96 pada 48 server MCP) dengan total biaya API $99,25.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi kelengkapan pada 298 server MCP dan evaluasi akurasi terhadap ground-truth manual pada 48 server MCP.
Protected_Object: Declarative MCP capability manifests (AgentManifest) during server onboarding
Composition_Evidence: Menghasilkan manifes kapabilitas pada tahap pendaftaran/delegasi server (B2) yang kemudian ditegakkan oleh mesin runtime AgentBound pada batas eksekusi (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Dekomposisi Klaim Sekunder Reviewer 2 (CLM-E01-004B): Memisahkan klaim sintesis kebijakan otomatis berbasis kode sumber (AgentManifestGen pada B2, akurasi 80,9% / 96,5%) dari klaim mesin penegakan runtime kontainer (AgentBound pada B3, overhead 0,6 ms).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas dekomposisi klaim AgentManifestGen (CLM-E01-004B).

Study_Title: AgentBreaker: Evaluating Context-Aware Indirect Prompt Injection Risks in Modern Web Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Web page adversary embedding context-aware indirect prompt injection (IPI) phrases into DOM/HTML elements to hijack multi-LLM autonomous web agents into clicking malicious elements, posting attacker text, or leaking secrets.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Context-aware Indirect Prompt Injection framework (AgentBreaker) using Strategist and Composer LLM modules, paired with a multi-layered runtime defense (DOM sanitization, instruction-data separation, and action verification).
Enforcement_Point_Location: Web Agent DOM Ingestion Parser, Multi-LLM Planner-Executor Interface, and Pre-Action Verification Filter
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Characterizes context-aware IPI vulnerability across 5 modern web agents (achieving 71.7%–100% ASR across 60 Online-Mind2Web pages) and demonstrates that combined context-aware defenses reduce ASR from 100% down to 1.7%.
Trust_Assumptions: Attacker can modify HTML/DOM elements on target webpages visited by the web agent but cannot modify the agent's internal system prompts or model weights.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 3, 11–16 (Section 5, Table 1): AgentBreaker achieves 71.7%–100% ASR across 5 web agents (100% on YuraScanner, Agent-E, BrowserOS, Nanobrowser; 96.7% on Skyvern) over 60 Online-Mind2Web webpages; proposed combined defenses reduce ASR from 100% to 1.7% (and mitigate adaptive split-phrase attacks).
Exposed_Security_Function: NOT_APPLICABLE — empirical context-aware IPI attack framework (AgentBreaker) and non-cryptographic DOM/prompt defense evaluation
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Web agents inherently trust DOM structure and accessibility trees; single-layer prompt guardrails fail against split-phrase adaptive injections (100% ASR without combined defense, p. 8).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 3 Section 1 (71.7%–100% ASR across 60 webpages, 96.7% on Skyvern, defense reduces ASR to 1.7%); pp. 6–8 Section 4 (AgentBreaker workflow, Fig. 1–3); pp. 9–15 Section 5 & Table 1 (Benchmark evaluation across 5 web agents).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: AgentBreaker menyusun frasa injeksi prompt tidak langsung (IPI) yang sadar konteks halaman secara otomatis dalam elemen HTML/DOM dan mencapai tingkat keberhasilan serangan (ASR) 71,7%–100% pada lima agen web mutakhir di 60 situs Online-Mind2Web, sementara kombinasi pertahanan yang diusulkan menekan ASR hingga 1,7%.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi serangan dan pertahanan pada 5 agen web (YuraScanner, Agent-E, BrowserOS, Nanobrowser, Skyvern) di 60 halaman web dunia nyata dari Online-Mind2Web.
Protected_Object: Web agent control flow, DOM action selection, and internal agent secrets
Composition_Evidence: Menunjukkan bagaimana manipulasi konteks DOM saat ingesti halaman (B1) merambat melintasi sub-agen perencana dan eksekutor untuk membajak eksekusi aksi browser (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (ISSTA'26) ini mendemonstrasikan kegagalan batas B1;B3 akibat IPI berbasis DOM pada agen web multi-LLM (DG) serta ketergantungan pada asumsi pemisahan instruksi-data di tingkat parser HTML (AD). Studi ini juga didekomposisi menjadi klaim pertahanan sekunder (CLM-E01-005B) untuk mekanisme mitigasi yang menurunkan ASR ke 1,7%.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas dekomposisi klaim serangan (71,7%–100% ASR) dan klaim pertahanan (1,7% ASR).

Study_Title: AgentBreaker: Evaluating Context-Aware Indirect Prompt Injection Risks in Modern Web Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Context-aware and adaptive split-phrase Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) attacks embedded in webpage DOM elements targeting multi-LLM web agents.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Multi-layered web-agent IPI defense combining DOM attribute sanitization, explicit instruction-data boundary marking, and pre-action alignment verification.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Web Agent DOM Pre-Processor and Pre-Action Execution Verifier
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Reduces the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of AgentBreaker on YuraScanner from 100% down to 1.7% across 60 Online-Mind2Web benchmark webpages and maintains robustness against adaptive split-phrase attacks (Section 6, pp. 1, 3, 16–18).
Trust_Assumptions: Web agent harness enforces DOM pre-processing and action verification outside the untrusted webpage context.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 1, 3, 16–18 (Section 6): combined defenses reduce AgentBreaker ASR from 100% to 1.7% across 60 benchmark websites while preserving benign web-crawling utility.
Exposed_Security_Function: DOM context sanitization and pre-action intent verification against context-aware IPI
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Single defense layers alone are bypassed by adaptive split-phrase injections (up to 100% ASR when uncombined, p. 8), and even the combined defense leaves a 1.7% residual ASR.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 3 Section 1 (defenses in combination reduce ASR of YuraScanner from 100% to 1.7%, including against adaptive adversary); pp. 16–18 Section 6 (Defense Design & Evaluation).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Kombinasi pertahanan berlapis yang diusulkan dalam studi AgentBreaker berhasil menurunkan tingkat keberhasilan serangan (ASR) injeksi prompt tidak langsung berbasis DOM dari 100% menjadi 1,7% sekaligus memitigasi serangan frasa-terpisah adaptif.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi pertahanan kombinatorial terhadap serangan standar dan adaptif AgentBreaker pada 60 situs web Online-Mind2Web.
Protected_Object: Web agent DOM ingestion context and browser action execution integrity
Composition_Evidence: Menggabungkan sanitasi atribut DOM saat ingesti (B1) dengan verifikasi aksi sebelum eksekusi klik/input peramban (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Dekomposisi Klaim Sekunder Reviewer 2 (CLM-E01-005B): Memisahkan evaluasi mekanisme pertahanan kombinatorial (menurunkan ASR dari 100% ke 1,7%) dari klaim kerangka serangan AgentBreaker (CLM-E01-005).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas dekomposisi klaim pertahanan CLM-E01-005B.

Study_Title: AgentSentinel: An End-to-End and Real-Time Security Defense Framework for Computer-Use Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Direct malicious instructions and third-party indirect prompt injections in tool outputs attempting data exfiltration, process termination, configuration tampering, or OS command injection via computer-use agents.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Real-time OS-level system call/operation interceptor, system tracer, and context-correlating LLM security auditor (AgentSentinel) enforcing a unidirectional trust boundary.
Enforcement_Point_Location: OS/Service Operation Interceptor and Real-Time Security Audit Monitor (AgentSentinel)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Real-time interception and halting of sensitive computer-use operations until context-correlated audit verification completes, achieving a 79.6% average defense success rate against the 60-scenario BadComputerUse benchmark (which has an 87% baseline ASR).
Trust_Assumptions: Initial user task prompt is provided before the unidirectional trust boundary is locked; OS kernel tracer and AgentSentinel monitor process are isolated from the untrusted agent runtime.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 2, 8–12 (Section 5, Tables 1–4): BadComputerUse benchmark (60 attack scenarios across 6 categories) achieves 87% average ASR on 4 frontier LLMs (92% on Claude 3.7 Sonnet); AgentSentinel achieves 79.6% average defense success rate with maximum audit wait timeout configured to 110 s.
Exposed_Security_Function: System trace interception, unidirectional trust boundary enforcement, and context-correlated LLM security auditing
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Achieves 79.6% defense success rate, leaving ~20.4% residual missed detections or false blocks under complex multi-step semantic obfuscation (DG); relies on LLM-based auditor reasoning and OS tracer isolation (AD).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (BadComputerUse 60 scenarios, 87% average ASR, AgentSentinel 79.6% average defense success rate); pp. 5–8 Section 4 (AgentSentinel Design, Fig. 3–4, unidirectional trust boundary); pp. 9–12 Section 5 & Tables 1–4.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: AgentSentinel mencegat operasi sensitif pada computer-use agent secara waktu nyata dan mengaudit korelasi antara konteks tugas serta trace sistem, mencapai rata-rata keberhasilan pertahanan 79,6% terhadap benchmark BadComputerUse (60 skenario dengan rata-rata ASR dasar 87%).
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi pada 4 LLM mutakhir menggunakan benchmark BadComputerUse (60 skenario di 6 kategori serangan OS/infrastruktur agen).
Protected_Object: Host operating system files, agent configuration files, running processes, and private user data
Composition_Evidence: Menggabungkan pencegatan eksekusi sensitif pada batas sistem operasi (B3) dengan korelasi trace audit waktu nyata (B4).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (CCS'25) ini menggabungkan pencegatan runtime (B3) dan audit korelasi trace sistem (B4). Diberi kode DG;AD karena rata-rata keberhasilan pertahanan 79,6% menyisakan ~20,4% celah deteksi pada serangan kompleks (DG) dan keamanan bergantung pada batas kepercayaan satu arah setelah input awal serta akurasi auditor LLM (AD). Benchmark serangan BadComputerUse juga didekomposisi sebagai klaim sekunder (CLM-E01-006B).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas pemisahan klaim pertahanan AgentSentinel (79,6% DSR) dan benchmark BadComputerUse (87% ASR).

Study_Title: AgentSentinel: An End-to-End and Real-Time Security Defense Framework for Computer-Use Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Six categories of attacks targeting computer-use agents and host OS resources (private data exfiltration, process termination, config tampering, indirect tool-result injection, command injection, and privilege abuse).
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: 60-scenario adversarial evaluation benchmark (BadComputerUse) spanning six attack categories against computer-use LLM agents.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Computer-Use Agent Prompt/Tool Ingestion and OS Execution Interface (Benchmark Surface)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Demonstrates an 87% average Attack Success Rate (ASR) across four state-of-the-art LLMs (reaching 92% ASR on Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Table 3 pp. 9–10) when operating without AgentSentinel.
Trust_Assumptions: Baseline computer-use agents rely on intrinsic LLM safety alignment without external OS-trace reference monitoring.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 1, 2, 9–10 (Section 5.1, Figure 5 & Table 3): across 60 attack scenarios in 6 categories on 4 frontier LLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-4-Turbo, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek), BadComputerUse achieves an 87% average ASR (exceeding 85% on most models and reaching 92% on Claude 3.7 Sonnet).
Exposed_Security_Function: NOT_APPLICABLE — empirical attack benchmark (BadComputerUse) quantifying computer-use agent vulnerability
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Proves that frontier LLMs (including Claude 3.7 Sonnet at 92% ASR) readily comply with direct and tool-output-injected OS compromise commands without host-level interception.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (BadComputerUse benchmark consisting of 60 diverse attack scenarios across 6 categories, 87% average ASR on 4 LLMs); pp. 9–10 Section 5.1, Figure 5 & Table 3 (92% ASR on Claude 3.7 Sonnet).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Benchmark BadComputerUse yang mencakup 60 skenario serangan di enam kategori membuktikan bahwa agen pengguna-komputer berbasis LLM sangat rentan, dengan rata-rata tingkat keberhasilan serangan (ASR) 87% pada empat LLM mutakhir (dan 92% pada Claude 3.7 Sonnet).
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi kerentanan dasar pada 4 LLM mutakhir di 60 skenario serangan sistem operasi dan infrastruktur agen.
Protected_Object: Computer-use agent infrastructure, configuration files, and host OS resources
Composition_Evidence: Menunjukkan bagaimana instruksi berbahaya dari pengguna maupun keluaran alat eksternal (B1) langsung diterjemahkan menjadi perintah sistem operasi berbahaya (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Dekomposisi Klaim Sekunder Reviewer 2 (CLM-E01-006B): Memisahkan kontribusi benchmark serangan BadComputerUse (EMPIRICAL_BENCHMARK, 87% ASR) dari mekanisme pertahanan AgentSentinel (DEFENSIVE_MECHANISM, 79,6% DSR).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas dekomposisi benchmark BadComputerUse (CLM-E01-006B).

Study_Title: AgentSpec: Customizable Runtime Enforcement for Safe and Reliable LLM Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Unsafe, vulnerability-inducing, or policy-violating actions generated by autonomous LLM agents across code execution, embodied robotics, and autonomous vehicle control.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Domain-Specific Language (AgentSpec) and runtime reference monitor enforcing structured event triggers, deterministic predicates, and enforcement actions (block, user inspection, self-reflection/regeneration).
Enforcement_Point_Location: Runtime Action/Tool Invocation Interceptor in the Agent Execution Loop
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Deterministic runtime compliance with specified safety rules (Definitions 3.1–3.3): prevents >90% of unsafe code agent executions, eliminates 100% of hazardous embodied agent actions, and enforces 100% law compliance in autonomous vehicle scenarios.
Trust_Assumptions: Runtime interceptor cannot be bypassed by the LLM agent; specified or LLM-generated predicates accurately capture domain hazards.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 9–10 (Section 5.5 RQ4): rule evaluation adds millisecond-level runtime overhead—averaging 1.42 ms for code-based scenarios (vs 25.4 s total agent runtime) and 1.11 ms for embodied agent scenarios (vs 9.82 s total runtime); o1-generated rules achieve 95.56% precision and 70.96% recall.
Exposed_Security_Function: AgentSpec DSL rule compilation, runtime event trigger interception, predicate checking, and action enforcement
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Automated LLM rule generation achieves 70.96% recall on risky code cases (missing ~29% of subtle vulnerabilities without human rule refinement, p. 9); enforces single-step state predicates rather than multi-step lookahead trajectory verification (Section 6.3, p. 11).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract (>90% code agent prevention, 100% embodied/AV compliance, ms overhead); pp. 3–5 Section 3 & Definitions 3.1–3.3 (AgentSpec syntax & operational semantics); pp. 6–10 Section 5 (95.56% precision, 70.96% recall, 1.42 ms code overhead, 1.11 ms embodied overhead).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: AgentSpec menyediakan bahasa spesifik domain (DSL) untuk penegakan batasan runtime yang dapat disesuaikan pada agen LLM, mencegah >90% eksekusi kode berbahaya dan 100% aksi berbahaya pada agen embodied/AV dengan overhead hanya 1,11–1,42 milidetik.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi pada agen eksekusi kode (RedCode-Exec), agen embodied (SafeAgentBench), dan kendaraan otonom (LawBreaker), termasuk pembuatan aturan otomatis dengan OpenAI o1.
Protected_Object: Host code execution environment, embodied physical safety invariants, and autonomous driving traffic rules
Composition_Evidence: Menegakkan semantik operasional deterministik (Definitions 3.1–3.3) pada titik eksekusi alat/aksi (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (ICSE'26) ini memformalkan semantik operasional DSL penegakan runtime (FORMAL_MODEL) dan mengukur latensi overhead secara presisi (1,11–1,42 ms). Diberi kode DG;AD karena recall aturan otomatis sebesar 70,96% pada skenario kode (DG) dan asumsi kelengkapan predikat aturan yang ditulis/dihasilkan untuk mendeteksi bahaya kontekstual (AD).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan overhead 1,11–1,42 ms pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: AirGapAgent: Protecting Privacy-Conscious Conversational Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Adversarial third-party applications executing context hijacking attacks via natural language queries to trick conversational personal agents into disclosing task-irrelevant private user data.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Contextual-integrity AirGapAgent architecture combining a trusted Context Minimizer (extracting only task-necessary user data based on the initial user directive) with an isolated Conversation Agent.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Pre-interaction Context Minimization Gateway between Private User Data Store and External Third-Party Interaction Loop
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Contextual data minimization and resistance to third-party context hijacking: increases private data protection under single-query context hijacking from 45% (baseline Gemini Ultra) to 97% while preserving task utility (Table 3, p. 2, 11).
Trust_Assumptions: Initial user task prompt and the Context Minimizer LLM invocation occur in a trusted, uncompromised environment prior to any interaction with the third-party app.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 2, 10–13 (Table 3): baseline Gemini Ultra privacy protection drops from 94% to 45% under context hijacking (leaking 55% of private fields), whereas AirGapAgent achieves 97% privacy protection across Gemini, GPT-4, and Mistral models with minimal utility degradation and one additional pre-conversation LLM call for minimization.
Exposed_Security_Function: Task-conditioned context minimization and air-gapped conversational state isolation
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Requires a static upfront task specification; if a legitimate multi-turn conversation dynamically requires additional private fields not anticipated during initial minimization, the agent must re-prompt the user for explicit escalation (Section 4.2, p. 6).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (protection drops from 94% to 45% on Gemini Ultra, AirGapAgent achieves 97% protection, Table 3); p. 3 Section 2 (Formal privacy definitions & threat model); pp. 6–7 Section 4 (AirGapAgent architecture, Fig. 4); pp. 10–12 Section 6 & Table 3.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: AirGapAgent mengisolasi data profil pengguna dari interaksi pihak ketiga melalui tahap minimisasi konteks berbasis integritas kontekstual, mempertahankan perlindungan privasi sebesar 97% terhadap serangan pembajakan konteks yang menjatuhkan agen standar dari 94% ke 45%.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi pada model keluarga Gemini, GPT, dan Mistral terhadap serangan pembajakan konteks satu-kueri dan multi-putaran pada dataset profil pengguna sintetis.
Protected_Object: Contextual private user profile attributes (medical, financial, personal identifiers)
Composition_Evidence: Memisahkan penurunan kapabilitas data dari instruksi pengguna yang tepercaya (B1) dan membatasi cakupan data yang didelegasikan ke agen percakapan saat bernegosiasi dengan pihak ketiga (B2).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (CCS'24) ini memformalkan definisi privasi integritas kontekstual (Section 2.1, p. 3) dan menegakkan pemisahan domain data pada B1;B2. Diberi kode AD karena jaminan bergantung pada asumsi bahwa minimizer LLM pertama tidak terpengaruh input musuh dan kebutuhan data dapat diprediksi sebelum negosiasi pihak ketiga dimulai.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas pemetaan batas B1;B2 dan metrik perlindungan 97% vs 45%.

Study_Title: ATAG: AI-Agent Application Threat Assessment with Attack Graphs
Threat_Attacker_Model: Multi-step adversaries exploiting prompt injection, excessive agency, sensitive information disclosure, and insecure output handling to pivot across interconnected agents in a Multi-Agent System (MAS).
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: MulVAL Datalog logic-based Attack Graph (AG) generation framework (ATAG) extended with custom MAS interaction rules and standardized LLM Vulnerability Database (LVD).
Enforcement_Point_Location: Offline/Pre-deployment Architectural Threat Assessment and Attack Graph Analyzer
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Automated logical derivation of multi-hop attack paths across interconnected agents and tools using Datalog interaction rules grounded in empirical LVD exploitability probabilities.
Trust_Assumptions: System architect provides an accurate topology specification (agents, communication channels, tool permissions) and vulnerability mapping in Datalog facts.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: Demonstrated on two representative multi-agent case studies (sequential Trip Planner and hierarchical Email Assistant, Sections 4.1–4.2, pp. 8–11); quantitative runtime overhead in ms is NOT_REPORTED.
Exposed_Security_Function: Datalog-based multi-agent attack graph generation and vulnerability path prioritization (ATAG + LVD)
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Static offline topological threat modeling tool that does not intercept or block runtime attacks; completeness of generated attack graphs depends entirely on the manually encoded Datalog rules and LVD coverage.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan lokasi. PDF p. 1 Abstract (ATAG extends MulVAL with custom Datalog facts/rules and LLM Vulnerability Database LVD); pp. 4–7 Section 3 & Tables 1–2 (ATAG Architecture Fig. 1, Datalog Interaction Rules, LVD records); pp. 8–11 Section 4 & Figures 2–5 (Trip Planner & Email Assistant case studies).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: ATAG memperluas mesin logika Datalog MulVAL dengan aturan interaksi khusus multi-agen dan basis data kerentanan LLM (LVD) untuk secara otomatis menghasilkan graf serangan multi-langkah yang memetakan perambatan eksploitasi antar-agen.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi bukti konsep pada dua arsitektur aplikasi multi-agen (Trip Planner sekuensial dan Email Assistant hierarkis).
Protected_Object: Multi-agent system topology, inter-agent communication channels, and connected external tools
Composition_Evidence: Memodelkan secara deduktif komposisi kerentanan multi-langkah mulai dari injeksi prompt awal (B1), perambatan pesan antar-agen (B2), hingga penyalahgunaan alat (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (ASIA CCS'26) ini menggunakan inferensi logika Datalog di atas MulVAL untuk memodelkan komposisi serangan multi-agen (LOGICAL_AXIOMS_WITH_PROOF). Diberi kode AD;UG karena ketergantungan penuh pada kelengkapan fakta/aturan Datalog statis (AD) dan evaluasi terbatas pada dua studi kasus arsitektur tanpa metrik skala besar (UG).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas klasifikasi FORMAL_FRAMEWORK dan cakupan studi kasus.

Study_Title: Authority Is Not a String: A Capability-Scoped Harness for Prompt-Injection-Resistant Coding Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Indirect prompt injection payloads embedded in repository files, issue descriptions, rule/skill files, or test outputs attempting unauthorized file modification or shell command execution in multi-agent coding harnesses.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Capability-scoped host reference monitor (CapScope) freezing a task-wide authority ceiling from trusted user input prior to repository ingestion and enforcing per-sub-agent attenuated typed capabilities (Read, Write, Exec) outside the model context.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Coding Agent Harness Reference Monitor at Sub-Agent Delegation and Tool Dispatch Boundaries
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Eliminates ambient authority and confused-deputy privilege escalation across orchestrator and sub-agents: reduces attack execution rate across 5 injection surfaces from 44.0% (unscoped baseline B0) and 29.3% (allowlist B1) down to 5.3% (4/75 runs, restricted solely to resources already required by the legitimate repair task, Table 2 p. 9).
Trust_Assumptions: Initial user task prompt and project directory tree (file names only) are trusted; host harness dispatch table cannot be modified by LLM context.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 6–9 Section 4 & Tables 2–3 (75 runs per condition across 5 Python repair tasks and 5 injection surfaces): CapScope (condition C) reduces executed attacks from 33/75 (44.0% in B0) to 4/75 (5.3%) while maintaining task repair success and mean wall-clock latency of 140–145 s (p. 8).
Exposed_Security_Function: Pre-ingestion authority ceiling prediction, per-sub-agent capability attenuation, and host-side tool dispatch authorization
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Cannot block in-scope malicious mutations when an injected payload targets the exact file or pytest command legitimately granted to that sub-agent (4/75 executed attacks in Table 2, p. 8–9).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract; pp. 3–4 Section 3.1–3.2 & Definition 1 (Capabilities as Typed Authority & Formal Semantics); pp. 6–9 Section 4 & Tables 2–3 (75 runs per condition, executed attacks reduced from 33/75 to 4/75, mean wall-clock 140–145 s).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: CapScope membekukan batas otoritas tingkat-tugas dari input tepercaya sebelum repositori dibaca dan memberikan kapabilitas bertipe yang dipersempit per sub-agen di luar konteks model, menekan eksekusi serangan injeksi prompt tidak langsung dari 33/75 (44,0%) menjadi 4/75 (5,3%) tanpa penalti latensi.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi pada agen pengkodean Pi dengan alur kerja orkestrator-subagen di 5 tugas perbaikan Python, 5 permukaan injeksi, dan 4 kondisi otorisasi (masing-masing 75 run).
Protected_Object: Repository source files, shell command execution privileges, and sub-agent authority boundaries
Composition_Evidence: Membekukan plafon otoritas dari niat pengguna sebelum membaca data tak tepercaya (B1), mempersempit kapabilitas saat delegasi ke sub-agen (B2), dan memverifikasi setiap pemanggilan alat di host monitor (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (LMPL'26) ini sangat kuat karena memformalkan kapabilitas bertipe (Definition 1, p. 3) dan mengevaluasi atenuasi otoritas lintas orkestrator-subagen (B1;B2;B3). Diberi kode DG;AD karena 4/75 serangan masih lolos ketika target injeksi berada di dalam file/perintah yang memang diizinkan untuk langkah perbaikan tersebut (DG) dan bergantung pada prediksi kapabilitas awal dari pohon direktori (AD).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan metrik Table 2–3 (4/75 vs 33/75, 140–145 s) pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: Blockchain Reputation Oracles: An MCP-Based Study
Threat_Attacker_Model: Unverifiable or hallucinated LLM reputation assessments, sybil/manipulated textual feedback, and opaque off-chain oracle updates in decentralized marketplaces and DAOs.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: MCP-coordinated Semantic Reputation Oracle combining contextual retrieval, LLM semantic inference, cryptographic transaction signing, and Ethereum smart-contract on-chain state commitment.
Enforcement_Point_Location: MCP Orchestration Pipeline and Ethereum Smart Contract Verification Layer
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Reproducible, cryptographically signed on-chain provenance of semantic reputation updates, improving trust-alignment accuracy by 22–28% over LLM-only baselines and reducing hallucination rates by 18–22% (Table 1, p. 6).
Trust_Assumptions: Ethereum-compatible blockchain consensus and oracle signing keys are secure; MCP orchestration server faithfully executes the three-stage pipeline.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 5–6 (Section 4.2, Tables 1–2): off-chain MCP pipeline latency (retrieval, inference, signing/broadcast) remains below 2.4 seconds per transaction (2.0–2.5 s), while total end-to-end latency including Ethereum testnet block inclusion is 17–18 seconds; alignment accuracy reaches up to 96.1% (+22–28% over LLM-only).
Exposed_Security_Function: MCP-supervised semantic trust evaluation, cryptographic oracle signing, and on-chain state commitment
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Evaluated retrospectively on historical datasets in an Ethereum testnet environment with no live adversarial deployment (Abstract, p. 1); relies on standard pre-quantum Ethereum ECDSA signatures and centralized MCP oracle coordination.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract (22–28% alignment improvement, 18–22% hallucination reduction, <2.4 s latency); pp. 2–4 Section 3 & Figure 1 (MCP-enabled Reputation Oracle workflow); pp. 5–6 Section 4.2 & Tables 1–2 (96.1% accuracy, 2.0–2.5 s MCP processing, 17–18 s testnet inclusion).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Orakel reputasi berbasis MCP menggabungkan penalaran semantik LLM dengan verifikasi dan komitmen on-chain Ethereum, meningkatkan akurasi penyelarasan kepercayaan sebesar 22–28% dan menekan halusinasi sebesar 18–22% dengan latensi pemrosesan MCP di bawah 2,4 detik per transaksi.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi retrospektif pada dataset historis dari pasar lepas (freelance), tata kelola DAO, dan komunitas berbagi energi di jaringan uji Ethereum.
Protected_Object: Decentralized reputation scores, semantic inference provenance, and on-chain state commitments
Composition_Evidence: Menghubungkan koordinasi pengambilan konteks dan inferensi melalui MCP (B3) dengan penandatanganan transaksi dan komitmen audit on-chain di Ethereum (B4).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream M (WETSEB'26) ini mendemonstrasikan integrasi MCP dengan komitmen on-chain Ethereum dan melaporkan dekomposisi latensi terperinci pada Table 2 (p. 6). Diberi kode STAGE_0_PRE_QUANTUM_ONLY (tanda tangan transaksi Ethereum klasik) serta AD;UG karena asumsi kejujuran node orakel MCP (AD) dan evaluasi post-hoc tanpa pengujian serangan langsung di jaringan utama (UG).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan dekomposisi latensi Table 2 (<2,4 s MCP, 17–18 s on-chain) pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: Confused Deputy Attack Against Model Context Protocol
Threat_Attacker_Model: External MCP server adversary executing a Confused Deputy attack (Puppet) via subtle metadata manipulation (selective requirement engineering, schema transformation, and lexical name prioritization) or post-trust rug-pull updates to hijack LLM tool selection without overtly malicious instructions.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Non-cryptographic automated metadata manipulation framework (Puppet) exploiting LLM preference biases in MCP tool selection.
Enforcement_Point_Location: MCP Host Tool Discovery Registry and LLM Metadata-Driven Tool Selection Layer
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Demonstrates a critical protocol-level vulnerability in MCP: Puppet achieves up to 90.89% tool selection hijacking rate (ASR_select) and up to 86.46% end-to-end malicious payload execution rate across 14 models on 2 MCP hosts while completely evading MCP-Scan and McpSafetyScanner.
Trust_Assumptions: User or workspace installs multiple MCP servers (or updates an existing server); MCP host relies on unverified plaintext metadata (server name, tool name, tool description) for LLM tool routing.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 5–6, 20–26 (Tables 1, 4–13): across 14 LLMs from 6 providers and 2 MCP hosts (Cursor/Cline), Puppet achieves up to 90.89% tool selection hijacking rate and up to 86.46% end-to-end attack success rate, with 0% detection by MCP-Scan and McpSafetyScanner; reasoning-enabled models exhibit higher vulnerability than non-reasoning models.
Exposed_Security_Function: NOT_APPLICABLE — empirical confused-deputy metadata attack framework (Puppet) against MCP tool discovery and selection
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Exposes fundamental design gaps in MCP's unauthenticated, non-deterministic tool routing and static security scanners (MCP-Scan, McpSafetyScanner) which only inspect for explicit prompt-injection strings rather than competitive semantic overshadowing.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (90.89% tool selection hijacking, 86.46% end-to-end execution across 14 models on 2 MCP hosts, undetected by MCP-Scan and McpSafetyScanner); pp. 5–6 Section 3 & Table 1 (metadata hierarchy); pp. 6–15 Section 4 (Puppet framework, Fig. 2); pp. 15–26 Section 5 & Tables 4–13.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Kerangka kerja serangan Puppet mengeksploitasi pemilihan alat berbasis metadata pada protokol MCP melalui rekayasa deskripsi dan prioritas leksikal, mencapai tingkat pembajakan pemilihan alat hingga 90,89% dan eksekusi muatan berbahaya ujung-ke-ujung hingga 86,46% di 14 model tanpa terdeteksi oleh MCP-Scan maupun McpSafetyScanner.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi komprehensif pada 14 LLM dari 6 penyedia di 2 host MCP populer serta pengujian penghindaran terhadap 2 pemindai keamanan MCP.
Protected_Object: MCP tool discovery integrity, LLM tool routing decisions, and downstream tool invocation arguments
Composition_Evidence: Menunjukkan bagaimana manipulasi metadata saat penemuan server/alat (B2) secara langsung membajak pemanggilan dan eksekusi alat oleh agen (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (TOSEM'26) ini membuktikan kerentanan struktural Confused Deputy pada batas B2;B3 di ekosistem MCP dan kegagalan total pemindai statis saat ini (DG;AD).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas pemetaan batas B2;B3 dan metrik 90,89% / 86,46%.

Study_Title: Creating Characteristically Auditable Agentic AI Systems
Threat_Attacker_Model: Crash faults, asynchronous network delays, Byzantine log-tampering adversaries, and colluding strategic agents attempting to omit, reorder, or forge post-execution audit records in multi-agent systems.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Eight-axiom formal auditability framework operationalized via origin-signed hash-linked tamper-evident logs, Byzantine quorum observers (q = ceil((n+f+1)/2), n > 3f), vector/logical clocks, and (epsilon=1.0, delta=10^-5) differential-privacy logging adaptors.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Distributed Multi-Agent Tamper-Evident Logging Infrastructure and Redundant Observer Quorum
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Formal inline proofs of Eventual Auditability under crash/network faults (Theorem 3.1), Game-Theoretic Incentive Compatibility for honest logging when p_e * P_e > C_e (Theorem 3.2), and Tamper-Evident Auditability under up to m Byzantine adversaries with m+1 observers (Theorem 3.3).
Trust_Assumptions: Every critical event is observed by at least m+1 distinct agents (at least one honest observer); network failures eventually heal (partial synchrony); digital signature and cryptographic hash primitives are unforgeable/collision-resistant.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: Analytical complexity and game-theoretic utility bounds derived inline (Sections 3–4, pp. 3–10); cites industrial OpenTelemetry 2024 benchmark reports in Related Work (p. 2) for motivation, but does not execute an empirical software benchmark (calibrated from pilot template).
Exposed_Security_Function: Cryptographically signed hash-linked audit logging, quorum observer cross-signing, and differentially private audit query adaptation
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Theorems 3.1–3.3 rely on strong observability and economic assumptions (every event observed by >= m+1 observers and detection penalty exceeding hiding benefit, pp. 4–7) and lack an empirical prototype benchmark implementation (UG).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan audit langsung PDF ter-pin. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Hypotheses H1–H3; pp. 2–7 Section 3 (Eight Auditability Axioms A1–A8, Theorem 3.1 Eventual Auditability, Theorem 3.2 Incentive Compatibility, Theorem 3.3 Byzantine Auditability); pp. 7–10 Section 4 (System Design Patterns, Fig. 1); p. 13 Table 1.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Memformalkan delapan aksioma auditabilitas sistem AI agenik dan membuktikan secara matematis auditabilitas eventual di bawah kegagalan asinkron (Theorem 3.1), kompatibilitas insentif permainan (Theorem 3.2), serta ketahanan terhadap lawan Byzantine melalui log berantai hash bertanda tangan dan kuorum pengamat (Theorem 3.3).
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Diaudit ulang oleh Reviewer 2 dari PDF SCR-0365_ACM-S-0030.pdf (14 hlm.): kerangka aksiomatik formal dan pembuktian teorema inline (Theorems 3.1–3.3) beserta pola desain arsitektural.
Protected_Object: Distributed multi-agent audit logs, event causality ordering, and privacy-regulated log attributes
Composition_Evidence: Mengomposisikan tanda tangan kriptografis berantai hash, jam logis, pengamat kuorum Byzantine, dan adaptasi privasi diferensial pada batas audit B4.
Coding_Rationale: Audit & Penyempurnaan Reviewer 2 atas draf pilot CLM-0023: Pemeriksaan langsung PDF membuktikan bahwa makalah ini adalah kerangka kerja formal murni dengan bukti teorema eksplisit (Theorems 3.1–3.3, pp. 4–7) dan tidak menjalankan eksperimen benchmark perangkat lunak baru (kutipan OpenTelemetry 2024 di p. 2 adalah studi literatur). Oleh karena itu, Claim_Category dikalibrasi menjadi FORMAL_FRAMEWORK, Implementation_Maturity menjadi FORMAL_MODEL_ONLY, dan Limitation_Codes menjadi AD;UG.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas kalibrasi FORMAL_FRAMEWORK / FORMAL_MODEL_ONLY untuk ACM-S-0030.

Study_Title: Dark Patterns Meet GUI Agents: LLM Agent Susceptibility to Manipulative Interfaces and the Role of Human Oversight
Threat_Attacker_Model: Deceptive and manipulative graphical user interface designs (16 dark pattern types across obstruction, sneaking, interface interference, forced action, and social engineering) steering GUI agents into unintended consent, privacy disclosure, or financial loss.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Non-cryptographic two-phase empirical vulnerability evaluation across 6 GUI agents (GPT-4o, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek V3, Gemini 2.0 Flash via Browser Use, plus OpenAI Operator and Claude CUA) and human-in-the-loop watch-mode oversight.
Enforcement_Point_Location: GUI Agent Visual/DOM Perception Pipeline and Human-in-the-Loop Watch-Mode Confirmation Interface
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Characterizes GUI agent susceptibility and human-oversight efficacy across 16 dark patterns: reveals that agents rarely recognize dark patterns (<=6/16 tasks) and consistently fail on Sneaking/Forced Action patterns (Bad Defaults, Hidden Information, Trick Questions, Forced Disclosure) unless end-to-end confirmation gates halt execution.
Trust_Assumptions: GUI agent operates on third-party web interfaces with user-delegated credentials and relies on DOM/screenshot parsing or human watch-mode intervention.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 8–15 (Tables 2–3, Phase 1 across 6 agents x 16 dark patterns; Phase 2 human study n=22 participants): adapted LLM agents achieved 0% avoidance on Bad Defaults, Hiding Information, Forced Disclosure, and Hidden Information (Table 2, p. 9); human oversight improved avoidance rates (Table 3, p. 12) but incurred attentional tunneling and cognitive load.
Exposed_Security_Function: NOT_APPLICABLE — empirical study of GUI agent susceptibility to 16 UI dark patterns and human oversight limitations
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Demonstrates that neither autonomous GUI agents nor human-in-the-loop watch modes provide reliable protection against covert interface manipulations due to agent goal-completion bias and human attentional tunneling.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract; pp. 6–9 Section 3 & Tables 1–2 (16 dark patterns, 6 GUI agents evaluation, avoidance vs awareness); pp. 10–15 Section 4 & Table 3 (Phase 2 human vs agent vs human-AI team avoidance rates, n=22).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Evaluasi dua fase terhadap 6 agen GUI dan 22 partisipan manusia pada 16 jenis dark pattern menunjukkan bahwa agen sering gagal mengenali manipulasi antarmuka (<=6/16) dan mengutamakan penyelesaian tugas di atas privasi/keamanan, sementara pengawasan manusia meningkatkan penghindaran namun terkendala attentional tunneling.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Studi empiris dua fase pada 16 situs web React berpola dark pattern dengan 6 agen GUI (4 Browser-Use + Operator + Claude CUA) dan 22 partisipan manusia.
Protected_Object: User privacy consent, financial decisions, and autonomous GUI action alignment
Composition_Evidence: Menghubungkan distorsi persepsi antarmuka dan niat pengguna pada batas ingesti/pengawasan (B1) dengan eksekusi aksi klik/formulir oleh agen GUI (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (CHI'26) ini membuktikan secara empiris kegagalan agen GUI dan pengawasan manusia terhadap manipulasi antarmuka (DG;AD) pada batas B1;B3.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas ekstraksi metrik Tabel 2–3.

Study_Title: Datura: Progressive Red Teaming Testing for Tool Invocation Chain in LLM Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Adversarial external tools and metadata providers executing progressive multi-step red-teaming attacks (Datura) that exploit implicit agent trust in tool metadata and intermediate tool outputs across state-dependent invocation chains.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Five-stage automated progressive red-teaming framework (Datura) combining metadata bias induction, bridge-tool output manipulation, and state-consistent multi-step chain construction.
Enforcement_Point_Location: LLM Agent Tool Selection and Multi-Step Tool Invocation Chain Interface
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Exposes severe multi-step tool-chain vulnerabilities across 5 LLMs and 740 safety-critical tasks under 5 defense settings: achieves 94.86%–99.59% ASR under Model Alignment, 78.78%–95.54% ASR under Prompt Refuge, and 65.81%–96.76% ASR on real-world agent platforms (Dify, Khoj).
Trust_Assumptions: Agent invokes external tools and incorporates tool metadata and intermediate outputs into its reasoning context without cryptographic provenance or semantic flow isolation.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 3, 6, 14–18 (Sections 4–6): across 740 safety-critical tasks and 5 LLMs, Datura achieves 94.86%–99.59% ASR under Model Alignment (+1.62 to +25.27 pp over baselines), 78.78%–95.54% ASR under Prompt Refuge, 65.81%–96.76% ASR on Dify, and 72.30%–92.30% ASR on Khoj.
Exposed_Security_Function: NOT_APPLICABLE — automated progressive tool-chain red-teaming framework (Datura)
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Demonstrates that single-turn alignment and prompt-isolation guardrails fail when malicious intent is distributed across individually benign steps in a tool invocation chain.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 3 Section 1.3 (740 safety-critical tasks, 5 LLMs, 5 defense settings: 94.86–99.59% ASR under Model Alignment, 78.78–95.54% under Prompt Refuge, 65.81–96.76% on Dify, 72.30–92.30% on Khoj); pp. 5–7 Section 4 (Tables 1–2); pp. 14–18 Section 6.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Datura mengeksploitasi kepercayaan implisit agen terhadap metadata dan keluaran alat melalui rantai pemanggilan alat progresif, mencapai ASR 94,86%–99,59% di bawah Model Alignment dan 65,81%–96,76% pada platform agen dunia nyata (Dify dan Khoj) di 740 tugas kritis.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi red-teaming terotomatisasi pada 5 LLM dan 740 tugas keselamatan kritis di bawah 5 mekanisme pertahanan serta platform Dify dan Khoj.
Protected_Object: Multi-step tool invocation chain integrity and agent reasoning state
Composition_Evidence: Membuktikan secara empiris kegagalan komposisi rantai alat multi-langkah: bias metadata pada pemilihan alat (B2) dikombinasikan dengan manipulasi keluaran jembatan untuk membajak eksekusi alat hilir (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (ISSTA'26) ini memberikan bukti komposisi serangan rantai alat multi-langkah yang sangat kuat pada batas B2;B3 dengan kode limitasi DG;AD.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas metrik ASR lintas 5 pertahanan.

Study_Title: Don't Let AI Agents YOLO Your Files: Information and Control in Agent-Native Filesystems
Threat_Attacker_Model: Unreliable or prompt-injected AI coding agents misusing filesystem access to corrupt, delete, or exfiltrate sensitive files (e.g., SSH keys, source repositories) while bypassing shell command filters and coarse sandboxes.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Agent-native filesystem (YoloFS) implementing three OS/filesystem primitives: effect introspection, snapshot-based mutation staging/undo, and progressive access gating.
Enforcement_Point_Location: OS Filesystem Layer (YoloFS FUSE/Kernel-level Staging, Snapshot, and Progressive Permission Gate)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Stages all agent filesystem mutations until explicit user commit, enables agent self-correction via intermediate snapshots (8/11 hidden-side-effect tasks), and enforces progressive least-privilege file access without degrading routine task success (99% on 112 tasks).
Trust_Assumptions: OS kernel and YoloFS filesystem mount are trusted and unbypassable by the unprivileged coding agent process; user reviews staged mutations before final commit.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 2, 12–15 (Section 6, Table 6 & Figure 11): on 11 tasks with hidden side effects, YoloFS stages 100% of mutations and enables self-correction in 8/11 tasks; on 112 routine coding tasks, matches 99% baseline success rate while reducing user confirmation prompts; commits >100,000 staged files in seconds with low metadata latency.
Exposed_Security_Function: Filesystem mutation staging, intermediate state snapshotting/undo, effect introspection, and progressive access gating
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Protects local filesystem state and read/write gates, but external network side effects occurring outside the filesystem boundary require complementary network mediation; relies on human inspection at final commit for subtle semantic bugs.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (290 public failure reports, YoloFS 3 primitives, 8/11 self-correction on hidden side-effect tasks, 99% success on 112 routine tasks); pp. 3–5 Section 3 (Table 1); pp. 6–11 Section 4–5 (YoloFS design); pp. 12–15 Section 6 & Table 6 / Fig. 11 (I/O & metadata latency).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Berdasarkan studi atas 290 laporan insiden agen pengkodean, YoloFS menggeser kontrol ke sistem berkas melalui primitif introspeksi efek, pembatalan mutasi bertahap (staging/snapshot), dan gerbang izin progresif, menangkal efek samping tersembunyi (koreksi mandiri pada 8/11 tugas) dan mempertahankan keberhasilan 99% pada 112 tugas rutin.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Studi empiris atas 290 laporan kegagalan publik serta evaluasi sistem YoloFS pada 11 tugas berefek samping tersembunyi, 112 tugas rutin, dan microbenchmark I/O sistem berkas.
Protected_Object: Host filesystem files, directories, sensitive credentials (SSH keys), and intermediate workspace states
Composition_Evidence: Menggabungkan gerbang akses progresif dan staging mutasi saat eksekusi (B3) dengan introspeksi efek dan pemulihan/audit berbasis snapshot (B4).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (SOSP'26) ini merancang sistem berkas khusus agen (YoloFS) yang menegakkan isolasi mutasi dan audit/rollback pada batas B3;B4 dengan evaluasi performa I/O terukur. Diberi kode AD karena asumsi bahwa efek samping berbahaya melalui kanal non-filesystem ditangani terpisah dan pengguna memverifikasi komit akhir.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan metrik throughput/latensi Table 6 & Fig. 11 pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: Evaluating Privilege Usage of Agents with Real-World Tools
Threat_Attacker_Model: Prompt injection attacks (direct and indirect/contextual) inducing LLM agents equipped with real-world MCP servers to abuse genuine cloud, database, and email privileges (e.g., dropping database tables, deleting cloud instances, exfiltrating emails).
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Containerized real-world MCP security evaluation sandbox (GrantBox) with automated MCP server deployment, SSE-Stdio proxy request logging, and benign/injection request synthesis.
Enforcement_Point_Location: MCP Server Sandbox Proxy (SSE-Stdio Proxy and Remote Request Logger)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Quantifies real-world privilege abuse under prompt injection across ReAct and Planning-based agents: demonstrates an overall average Attack Success Rate (ASR) of 84.80% (90.55% in ReAct mode and 79.05% in Planning mode across evaluated LLMs, Table 2 p. 4).
Trust_Assumptions: Evaluated agents operate with standard MCP tool access without fine-grained privilege attenuation or external reference monitors.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 2, 4 (Section 3, Tables 1–2): across real-world MCP servers (cloud-ops, database, email, file), crafted prompt injections achieve 84.80% overall average ASR—90.55% average ASR on ReAct agents (with GPT-5 and Gemini-3-Flash exceeding 90%) and 79.05% average ASR on Planning-based agents.
Exposed_Security_Function: NOT_APPLICABLE — empirical sandbox benchmark (GrantBox) evaluating agent privilege misuse on real-world MCP tools
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Shows that LLM intrinsic safety awareness and planning-before-execution reduce ASR by only ~11.5 percentage points (from 90.55% to 79.05%), leaving critical cloud/DB privileges highly exposed.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract (84.80% average ASR); p. 2 Section 1–2 & Figure 1 (GrantBox framework, 90.55% ReAct ASR vs 79.05% Planning ASR); pp. 3–4 Section 3 & Tables 1–2 (Integrated MCP servers and ASR across LLMs).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: GrantBox mengintegrasikan server MCP dunia nyata ke dalam sandbox evaluasi keamanan dan menunjukkan bahwa agen LLM sangat rentan terhadap penyalahgunaan hak istimewa di bawah serangan injeksi prompt, dengan rata-rata ASR 84,80% (90,55% pada agen ReAct dan 79,05% pada agen berbasis perencanaan).
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi empiris pada agen berbasis ReAct dan Planning lintas berbagai LLM menggunakan server MCP dunia nyata (manajemen cloud, basis data, email).
Protected_Object: Real-world MCP tool privileges (cloud infrastructure, relational databases, email accounts)
Composition_Evidence: Mengukur secara langsung bagaimana instruksi berbahaya yang disuntikkan menerjemahkan hak istimewa agen menjadi eksekusi perintah destruktif pada server MCP nyata di batas B3.
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (FSE Companion'26) ini menyajikan benchmark empiris penyalahgunaan hak istimewa pada alat MCP nyata (B3) dengan bukti kuantitatif kegagalan penjagaan berbasis model (DG;AD).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas angka ASR 84,80% (90,55% ReAct / 79,05% Planning).

Study_Title: Foundations for Investigations of Agentic AI Systems from the Forensic Analysis of OpenClaw
Threat_Attacker_Model: Post-incident forensic reconstruction challenges in autonomous personal AI assistants (OpenClaw), where nondeterministic LLM reasoning, ephemeral state transitions, and unfaithful chain-of-thought logs obscure unauthorized actions or system compromises.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Differential disk/state forensic analysis pipeline, Five-Plane Agent Artifact Taxonomy (Configuration, Communication, Knowledge/Memory, Reasoning/Cognition, Execution/Action), and open-source forensic artifact extraction tool.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Post-Incident Host Filesystem and Local State Directory (.openclaw) Forensic Extractor
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Systematically maps recoverable local forensic artifacts across all 5 planes of the OpenClaw agent loop (Table 1, p. 7) and cross-maps completeness against ChatGPT mobile and Copilot (Table 2, p. 15), proving that LLM reasoning traces cannot be treated as self-authenticating evidence of external actions.
Trust_Assumptions: Host disk images and local .openclaw directory artifacts are preserved without root-level anti-forensic wiping; investigators correlate model reasoning traces with independent OS/network execution logs.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: Qualitative and structural completeness evaluation across 5 artifact planes on OpenClaw and 2 cross-mapped systems (Tables 1–2, pp. 7, 14–15); runtime latency overhead in ms is NOT_REPORTED.
Exposed_Security_Function: Differential forensic state extraction and five-plane agent artifact correlation
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Local OpenClaw artifacts lack cryptographic tamper-evidence or origin signatures; LLM reasoning traces ('thought signatures') may omit unverbalized cues or hallucinate tool execution outcomes (p. 1, 16).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan audit langsung PDF ter-pin. PDF p. 1 Abstract; pp. 5–6 Section 3 & Fig. 2 (Differential Forensic Analysis workflow); pp. 6–12 Section 4 & Table 1 (OpenClaw artifact locations in .openclaw); pp. 13–16 Section 5–6, Fig. 3 & Table 2 (Five-Plane Agent Artifact Taxonomy & unfaithfulness of reasoning traces).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Studi forensik diferensial pertama atas asisten AI agenik OpenClaw menghasilkan taksonomi artefak lima-bidang dan alat ekstraksi sumber terbuka, serta membuktikan bahwa jejak penalaran internal LLM tidak dapat dipercaya sebagai bukti forensik mandiri tanpa korelasi artefak eksekusi.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Diaudit ulang oleh Reviewer 2 dari PDF SCR-0371_ACM-S-0036.pdf (20 hlm.): analisis kode statis dan forensik diferensial citra disk pada OpenClaw serta pemetaan lintas-sistem terhadap 2 sistem AI terkait (Table 2).
Protected_Object: Post-incident forensic evidence artifacts across configuration, communication, memory, reasoning, and tool execution planes
Composition_Evidence: Mengkorelasikan artefak pada batas audit pasca-eksekusi (B4) dengan jejak memori, komunikasi, dan pemanggilan alat untuk merekonstruksi insiden.
Coding_Rationale: Audit & Penyempurnaan Reviewer 2 atas draf pilot CLM-0024: Mengonfirmasi kategori EMPIRICAL_BENCHMARK pada B4 dan kode DG;AD karena artefak log OpenClaw disimpan tanpa penyegelan kriptografis (AD) serta penalaran LLM terbukti nondeterministik dan tidak selalu mencerminkan eksekusi nyata (DG). Kolom Performance_Overhead_Reported disempurnakan agar secara akurat mencerminkan evaluasi kelengkapan struktural Tabel 1–2 (NOT_REPORTED untuk latensi ms).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas pemetaan artefak Tabel 1–2.

Study_Title: Governance by Construction for Generalist Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Unconstrained autonomous agent behavior, out-of-policy tool invocations, unauthorized high-risk actions, and sensitive data exposure in enterprise generalist agent workflows.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Modular policy-as-code runtime governance architecture (CUGA Policy System) enforcing typed interventions at five structural checkpoints: Intent Guard, Playbook, Tool Guide, Human-in-the-Loop Tool Approvals, and Output Formatter.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Five-Stage Runtime Governance Checkpoints (Pre-Planning Intent Guard, System Prompt Playbook, Tool-Call Boundary, HITL Gate, Output Formatter)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Policy-by-construction enforcement across the agent lifecycle, improving task compliance and Success Rate on OAK Bench (75%->100% on GPT-OSS-120B, 70%->96% on GPT-4.1, 81%->96% on Claude Opus-4.5) and BPO-Bench (49.2%->82.3%, 28.5%->66.2%, 50.0%->68.5%, Table 1 p. 4).
Trust_Assumptions: CUGA runtime harness and keyword/embedding policy triggers execute deterministically outside model weights; human approvers accurately vet flagged high-risk tool calls.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 4–8 (Tables 1–6): on OAK and BPO benchmarks across 3 frontier LLMs, CUGA's policy system boosts SR by +15 to +37.7 percentage points and API accuracy from 50.0% to 73.1% (+23.1 pp, Table 3 p. 6), while Table 6 (p. 8) quantifies token usage overhead across configurations.
Exposed_Security_Function: Five-checkpoint policy-as-code interception (Intent Guard, Playbook, Tool Guide, Tool Approval, Output Formatter)
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Policy matching relies on keyword and embedding-similarity triggers, and Playbook/Tool Guide rules still depend partly on LLM instruction following during plan generation (6/26 BPO tasks remain unsolved or partially solved in Table 5, p. 7).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan audit langsung PDF ter-pin. PDF p. 1 Abstract (five structural checkpoints); pp. 2–3 Section 2 (Intent Guard, Playbook, Tool Approval, Tool Guide, Output Formatter); pp. 4–8 Section 4 & Tables 1–6 (OAK & BPO benchmark SR gains +15 to +37.7 pp, API accuracy 50.0%->73.1%, Table 6 token usage).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Sistem kebijakan CUGA menegakkan tata kelola runtime melalui lima titik pemeriksaan struktural (Intent Guard, Playbook, Tool Guide, Tool Approvals, Output Formatter), meningkatkan tingkat keberhasilan kepatuhan tugas sebesar +15 hingga +37,7 poin persentase pada benchmark OAK dan BPO.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Diaudit ulang oleh Reviewer 2 dari PDF SCR-0373_ACM-S-0038.pdf (8 hlm.): evaluasi ablasi dan overhead token pada benchmark OAK dan BPO (26 tugas proses bisnis) lintas 3 model (GPT-OSS-120B, GPT-4.1, Claude Opus-4.5).
Protected_Object: Enterprise business process workflows, tool invocation compliance, and agent output formatting
Composition_Evidence: Menyematkan intersep kebijakan secara berkesinambungan dari penyaringan niat awal (B1), pembentukan rencana/delegasi (B2), hingga persetujuan pemanggilan alat dan penyaringan keluaran (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Audit & Penyempurnaan Reviewer 2 atas draf pilot CLM-0025: Mengubah Target_Boundary dari B2_DELEGATION_TO_REQUEST menjadi MULTI_BOUNDARY (B1;B2;B3) karena lima titik intersep CUGA secara eksplisit mencakup Intent Guard (B1), Playbook (B2), dan Tool Guide/Approval (B3). Menambahkan metrik kuantitatif eksak dari Tabel 1, 3, dan 6 (pp. 4–8).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas pemetaan MULTI_BOUNDARY (B1;B2;B3) dan pencatatan metrik Tabel 1 & 6 pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: Guixu: Valuation-Driven Data Discovery for Autonomous AI Agents with On-Chain Attestation
Threat_Attacker_Model: Untrusted, low-utility, or misrepresented external datasets in decentralized data marketplaces causing autonomous agents to waste procurement budgets or ingest low-quality/unverified data.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Valuation-driven data discovery and procurement system (Guixu) integrating a three-phase valuation pipeline with agentic payment protocols (x402 / Machine Payment Protocol MPP) and blockchain on-chain attestation signals (seller reputation, transaction volume, verifiable usage feedback).
Enforcement_Point_Location: Agent Data Discovery Engine, Agentic Payment Gateway (x402/MPP), and On-Chain Attestation Indexer
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Verifiable on-chain trust attestation and budget-constrained portfolio optimization for autonomous agent data procurement.
Trust_Assumptions: Underlying blockchain ledger and smart contracts provide tamper-resistant transaction history and attestation records; proxy-label propagation reflects downstream task utility.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: 4-page VLDB demonstration paper illustrating two interactive procurement workflows (Section 3, p. 4); quantitative runtime latency or security overhead in ms is NOT_REPORTED.
Exposed_Security_Function: On-chain attestation signal indexing, tiered trust classification, and x402/MPP agentic payment execution
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Demonstration paper (4 pages) without quantitative adversarial evaluation (e.g., sybil wash-trading or data poisoning resistance) or latency benchmarks (UG); relies on blockchain ledger finality and honest attestation feedback (AD).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan lokasi. PDF p. 1 Abstract; pp. 2–3 Section 2 & Figures 1–3 (Guixu workflow, three-phase valuation pipeline, x402/MPP agentic payment, on-chain data market & attestation trust layer); p. 4 Section 3 (Demonstration scenarios).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Guixu mengintegrasikan penilaian utilitas data tiga-fase dengan protokol pembayaran agenik (x402/MPP) dan sinyal atestasi on-chain untuk memfasilitasi penemuan serta pengadaan data yang tepercaya bagi agen otonom.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Makalah demonstrasi sistem (VLDB'26, 4 hlm.) dengan dua skenario alur kerja interaktif tanpa evaluasi benchmark kuantitatif.
Protected_Object: Autonomous agent data procurement budget, dataset provenance, and seller trust ratings
Composition_Evidence: Menghubungkan penemuan sumber data berbasis reputasi on-chain (B2), eksekusi pembayaran agenik x402/MPP (B3), dan umpan balik atestasi transaksi ke ledger (B4).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream M (VLDB'26 Demo) ini relevan untuk pengadaan sumber daya agen berbasis atestasi on-chain dan pembayaran x402/MPP (B2;B3;B4), tetapi karena berformat demo 4 halaman tanpa metrik eksperimental kuantitatif, diberi status PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED dan kode limitasi AD;UG.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas status PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED (makalah demonstrasi tanpa eksperimen kuantitatif).

Study_Title: How Your Credentials Are Leaked by LLM Agent Skills: An Empirical Study
Threat_Attacker_Model: Negligent skill developers and malicious third-party skill authors in open-source agent skill marketplaces (SkillsMP) exposing or exfiltrating sensitive user credentials (API keys, OAuth tokens, DB passwords, cloud secrets) during skill installation or runtime execution.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Cross-modal empirical vulnerability analysis pipeline combining static secret extraction (regex + AST parsing), dynamic sandbox testing with mock credentials, and intent-behavior cross-referencing across 17,022 sampled skills.
