Enforcement_Point_Location: Offline/Sandbox Skill Marketplace Security Analysis Pipeline (Static AST/Regex + Dynamic Mock-Credential Sandbox)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Uncovers 520 affected skills with 1,708 security issues across 17,022 sampled SkillsMP artifacts (437 vulnerable skills with 1,371 issues and 83 malicious skills with 337 issues) organized into a 10-pattern leakage taxonomy.
Trust_Assumptions: Agent skills execute with the host agent's ambient runtime privileges and access environment variables/credentials without fine-grained secret isolation.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 6–8 (Section 4, Tables 1–2): analyzed 17,022 skills (10% stratified sample of 170,226 SkillsMP skills), identifying 520 credential-leaking skills (1,708 issues); 76.3% of cases are cross-modal (requiring joint NL prompt and code analysis), 73.5% of vulnerable issues stem from debug logging (print/console.log), and 89.6% of leaked credentials are immediately exploitable (92.5% during routine execution without elevated privileges).
Exposed_Security_Function: NOT_APPLICABLE — large-scale empirical study and taxonomy of credential leakage in LLM agent skills
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Demonstrates that 76.3% of skill credential leaks span natural-language markdown instructions and code logic, causing traditional code-only static analyzers to miss cross-modal exfiltration.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (17,022 skills sampled from 170,226 on SkillsMP, 520 affected skills, 1,708 issues, 10 leakage patterns, 76.3% cross-modal, 73.5% debug logging, 89.6% immediately exploitable); pp. 3–6 Section 3 (Methodology, Fig. 2, Table 1); pp. 6–9 Section 4 & Table 2.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Studi empiris skala besar terhadap 17.022 skill agen dari SkillsMP mengidentifikasi 520 skill bermasalah yang memuat 1.708 kebocoran kredensial dalam 10 pola (437 skill rentan dan 83 skill berbahaya), di mana 76,3% kasus bersifat lintas-modal (bahasa alami + kode) dan 89,6% kredensial yang bocor dapat langsung dieksploitasi.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Analisis statis (AST/regex), pengujian sandbox dinamis dengan kredensial tiruan, dan klasifikasi manual pada 17.022 skill dari repositori SkillsMP.
Protected_Object: Long-term API keys, OAuth tokens, cloud credentials, and database secrets handled by agent skills
Composition_Evidence: Menunjukkan bagaimana instruksi bahasa alami di dalam deskripsi skill berinteraksi dengan kode eksekusi skill untuk membocorkan kredensial jangka panjang pada batas B3.
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (ASE'26) ini memberikan karakterisasi kuantitatif atas kebocoran kredensial jangka panjang (LONG_TERM_CREDENTIAL) pada eksekusi skill agen (B3) dengan kode limitasi DG;AD.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas angka prevalensi 520 skill / 1.708 isu.

Study_Title: Improving Google A2A Protocol: Protecting Sensitive Data and Mitigating Unintended Harms in Multi-Agent Systems
Threat_Attacker_Model: Semi-trusted or prompt-injected peer agents in multi-agent A2A workflows attempting unauthorized PII/payment credential disclosure, token replay, privilege escalation via coarse scopes, or unconsented high-stakes actions.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Enhanced Google A2A protocol integrating OAuth 2.0 / RSA-signed JWTs with short-lived single-use scoped tokens (TTL 30 s to 5 min, e.g., ttl=120 s), Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) explicit user consent orchestration, and direct user-to-service encrypted data channels.
Enforcement_Point_Location: A2A Protocol Authorization Server, Consent Orchestration Gateway, and Direct User-to-Service Data Channel
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Prevents sensitive data exposure to intermediary orchestrator agents and blocks prompt-injection-induced credential theft (which achieved 60%–100% ASR on baseline A2A workflows, Section VIII p. 9) by routing PII/payment data through direct user-to-service channels and enforcing short-lived single-use JWTs.
Trust_Assumptions: RSA key pairs, TLS transport, and the external Consent/Authorization Service are uncompromised; user devices faithfully render SCA consent prompts.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 9–11 (Sections VIII–IX): baseline A2A suffers 60%–100% prompt-injection data leakage ASR across obfuscation strategies (p. 9), whereas the enhanced A2A protocol with ephemeral tokens (ttl=120 s) and direct data flow blocks intermediate agent leakage while adding only 0.2 to 0.8 seconds of end-to-end communication latency (p. 11).
Exposed_Security_Function: Short-lived single-use RSA-signed JWT issuance, explicit SCA user consent orchestration, and direct user-to-service PII bypass channel
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Relies on classical RSA-signed JWTs (STAGE_0_PRE_QUANTUM_ONLY) and assumes that external service providers support direct user-to-service out-of-band token redemption and SCA consent callbacks.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract; p. 2 Section II (A2A AgentCard, OAuth 2.0 & RSA-signed JWTs, Fig. 1); pp. 3–6 Section III–IV (Threat model Fig. 2, vulnerabilities Fig. 3, ephemeral token TTL 30s–5min); pp. 7–11 Sections V–IX (Consent orchestration, prompt injection ASR 60%–100% mitigated, ttl=120s, latency overhead 0.2–0.8 s).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Penyempurnaan protokol Google A2A memperkenalkan orkestrasi persetujuan eksplisit pengguna, token JWT bertanda tangan RSA sekali-pakai berumur pendek (TTL 30 detik–5 menit), dan kanal data langsung pengguna-ke-layanan untuk mengeliminasi kebocoran data sensitif akibat injeksi prompt (ASR dasar 60%–100%) dengan tambahan latensi hanya 0,2–0,8 detik.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Analisis kerentanan protokol A2A, implementasi pola aliran data langsung dan token berumur pendek, serta evaluasi injeksi prompt empiris dan perbandingan protokol.
Protected_Object: Payment credentials, identity documents, and OAuth/JWT delegation tokens in multi-agent A2A workflows
Composition_Evidence: Mengikat persetujuan eksplisit pengguna (B1) dengan penerbitan token JWT sekali-pakai berlingkup sempit antar-agen (B2) dan pengiriman data sensitif langsung ke layanan akhir (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (TOSEM'26) ini secara eksplisit memodifikasi mekanisme token JWT bertanda tangan RSA dan OAuth 2.0 pada protokol Google A2A (B1;B2;B3), melaporkan masa hidup token `SHORT_LIVED_TOKEN` (30 detik–5 menit) dan latensi 0,2–0,8 detik. Diberi kode STAGE_0_PRE_QUANTUM_ONLY karena menggunakan RSA klasik tanpa migrasi PQC, serta AD karena asumsi dukungan kanal langsung pada penyedia layanan.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan overhead latensi 0,2–0,8 detik pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: In Code They Think; In Proof We Trust
Threat_Attacker_Model: Indirect prompt injection hijacking tool-using agents into exfiltrating sensitive data (e.g., local files) to attacker-controlled endpoints, including via steganography, encryption, or chunking that evade content-based runtime scanners.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Preemptive static taint analysis and Proof-Carrying Code (PCC) verification over agent plans expressed as a constrained Kotlin DSL, verified via three Constrained Horn Clauses (CHCs) in Z3's SPACER engine and an independent deterministic certificate checker.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Pre-Execution Plan Compiler and Proof-Carrying Code Certificate Checker (prior to any tool invocation)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Provenance-based non-exfiltration guarantee: any transitive data-flow path from a sensitive source to an untrusted network sink is statically rejected prior to tool execution, regardless of content encoding or obfuscation.
Trust_Assumptions: Source and sink security annotations in tool specifications are complete and accurate; the small deterministic AST fact extractor and PCC certificate checker (TCB) are faithfully implemented; implicit control-flow covert channels have negligible bandwidth.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: Architectural and algorithmic specification with executable Kotlin taint-propagation and PCC checker code listings and Z3 SPACER CHC encoding (pp. 7–23); numerical wall-clock benchmark timings in ms are NOT_REPORTED in the article text (calibrated from pilot template).
Exposed_Security_Function: Kotlin AST fact extraction, transitive taint closure verification (Z3 SPACER CHCs), and Proof-Carrying Code certificate checking
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Requires the agent to express its entire interaction plan upfront as a static Kotlin script before execution (limiting dynamic reactiveness to runtime tool outputs); explicitly notes that implicit control-flow covert channels are not blocked in theory (p. 21) and does not report large-scale benchmark timings (UG).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan audit langsung PDF ter-pin. PDF pp. 1–2 Abstract & Introduction (Kotlin DSL plan, static taint analysis, Proof-Carrying Code certificate checker, Z3 SPACER Constrained Horn Clauses); pp. 7–15 Figures 1–2 & Kotlin taint analyzer code (grounding invariant & transitive closure postcondition); pp. 19–24 Figure 3 & PCC checker / implicit flow limitation.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Menggantikan penjaga runtime reaktif dengan verifikasi statis pra-eksekusi berbasis Proof-Carrying Code (PCC) dan analisis taint (diverifikasi melalui Constrained Horn Clauses di Z3 SPACER) atas rencana agen yang ditulis dalam DSL Kotlin untuk menjamin tiadanya jalur eksfiltrasi data sensitif.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Diaudit ulang oleh Reviewer 2 dari PDF SCR-0379_ACM-S-0044.pdf (ACM Queue, 25 hlm.): desain formal dan implementasi pemeriksa sertifikat PCC/taint dalam Kotlin + Z3 SPACER pada skenario eksfiltrasi dokumen.
Protected_Object: Sensitive user files and data sources accessed by tool-using agents
Composition_Evidence: Memverifikasi rencana komposisi pemanggilan alat secara menyeluruh pada tahap perencanaan (B2) sebelum mengizinkan eksekusi alat pertama (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Audit & Penyempurnaan Reviewer 2 atas draf pilot CLM-0026: Mengonfirmasi TOOL_SUPPORTED_VERIFICATION (Z3 SPACER CHC + pemeriksa PCC deterministik). Mengalibrasi Target_Boundary ke MULTI_BOUNDARY (B2;B3), Implementation_Maturity ke PROOF_OF_CONCEPT, dan Performance_Overhead_Reported ke NOT_REPORTED untuk angka ms karena artikel ACM Queue ini menampilkan kode pemeriksa lengkap namun tidak memuat tabel pengukuran waktu eksekusi milidetik, serta menambahkan kode UG menjadi AD;UG.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas kalibrasi PROOF_OF_CONCEPT dan pencatatan ketiadaan tabel latensi numerik.

Study_Title: Integrating OpenClaw Agents with Zero Trust Architecture for Secure Multi- Tenant HPC Environments
Threat_Attacker_Model: Stolen token replay, cross-tenant Slurm queue/storage access, prompt-induced job cancellation (scancel), and over-privileged non-human agent identities in multi-tenant HPC clusters.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Zero-Trust HPC agent integration (ZT-OpenClaw-HPC) combining SPIFFE/SPIRE cryptographic workload identities (short-lived X.509/JWT SVIDs), per-action Policy Decision/Enforcement Points (PDP/PEP), short-lived task tokens, and tamper-evident audit logging.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Slurm Control-Plane PEP Hooks, SPIRE Workload Attestation Agent, and Tenant-Scoped Gateway
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Eliminates static service secrets and reduces unauthorized cross-tenant execution and stolen-token replay success to 0% (100% policy blocking and 100% audit completeness across 160 red-team misuse attempts, Table 5 p. 5).
Trust_Assumptions: SPIRE server/node attestation root of trust, Slurm control-plane PEP hooks, and tenant policy definitions are uncompromised.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 4–5 (Section 5, Tables 1–6): evaluated across 4 HPC workloads and 160 misuse attempts (D_a); reduces unauthorized cross-tenant execution and credential exposure to 0% (Table 5); control-plane p50/p95 decision latency is 192/261 ms (p99 386 ms) for queue query and 286/352 ms (p99 514 ms) for job submission vs 118/146 ms and 164/201 ms static baseline (Table 6, p. 5).
Exposed_Security_Function: SPIFFE/SPIRE workload attestation (SVID issuance), per-action tenant-aware PDP/PEP authorization, and audit logging
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Evaluated on a single-cluster Slurm prototype testbed with synthetic agent trace datasets (Section 5.1, p. 3–4); adds ~74–122 ms p50 control-plane latency per action.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract; pp. 2–3 Sections 3–4 & Figures 1–2 (ZT-OpenClaw-HPC architecture, SPIFFE/SPIRE SVIDs, Slurm PEP hooks); pp. 4–5 Section 5 & Tables 1–6 (160 misuse attempts, 0% unauthorized execution, Table 6 p50/p95/p99 latencies: 192/261/386 ms queue query, 286/352/514 ms job submission).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: ZT-OpenClaw-HPC mengintegrasikan agen OpenClaw dengan identitas beban kerja kriptografis SPIFFE/SPIRE (SVID berumur pendek) dan penegakan kebijakan per-aksi pada klaster HPC Slurm multi-tenant, menekan eksekusi lintas-tenant tidak sah menjadi 0% dari 160 percobaan serangan dengan latensi p50 bidang kontrol 192–286 ms.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi purwarupa berbasis Slurm pada 4 beban kerja HPC representatif dan 160 skenario penyalahgunaan red-team dibandingkan terhadap 3 baseline.
Protected_Object: Multi-tenant Slurm HPC jobs, project storage directories, workload identities (SVIDs), and control-plane audit logs
Composition_Evidence: Mengomposisikan atestasi identitas beban kerja SPIFFE/SPIRE dan token berumur pendek (B2), intersep PEP per-aksi pada Slurm (B3), serta pencatatan audit terverifikasi (B4).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream M_AND_A (HP3C'26) ini mengintegrasikan SPIFFE/SPIRE SVIDs dengan mediasi Slurm PEP dan menyajikan metrik latensi p50/p95/p99 yang sangat lengkap pada Table 6 (p. 5). Diberi kode STAGE_0_PRE_QUANTUM_ONLY (SVID X.509/JWT klasik) dan AD;UG karena pengujian dilakukan pada dataset sintetis di satu testbed prototipe. Juga didekomposisi menjadi klaim sekunder (CLM-E01-024B) untuk evaluasi overhead bidang kontrol.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan metrik Table 5–6 pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: Integrating OpenClaw Agents with Zero Trust Architecture for Secure Multi- Tenant HPC Environments
Threat_Attacker_Model: Control-plane latency and false-denial bottlenecks when enforcing per-action zero-trust attestation and policy checks on high-throughput multi-tenant Slurm HPC workloads.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Slurm control-plane latency and security-effectiveness benchmark across 4 HPC workload classes (queue query, job submission, job cancellation, storage access) and 3 baseline architectures.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Slurm Control-Plane PEP/PDP Mediation Pipeline
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Quantifies the exact control-plane latency overhead of continuous SVID verification, PDP evaluation, and audit logging across 4 HPC operations: p50 latency increases from 118–164 ms (static baseline) to 192–286 ms (p95 261–352 ms, p99 386–514 ms, Table 6 p. 5) with low false-denial rate.
Trust_Assumptions: Synthetic trace benchmark accurately reflects control-plane request distributions in multi-tenant Slurm HPC clusters.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 5 Table 6: Queue query p50=192 ms, p95=261 ms, p99=386 ms (vs 118/146/238 ms baseline); Job submission p50=286 ms, p95=352 ms, p99=514 ms (vs 164/201/316 ms); Job cancel p50=242 ms, p95=318 ms, p99=472 ms (vs 141/188/302 ms); Storage access p50=214 ms, p95=297 ms, p99=446 ms (vs 129/171/287 ms).
Exposed_Security_Function: Per-action SVID verification, PDP policy evaluation, and control-plane audit logging latency benchmarking
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Adds 74–122 ms p50 (and up to 198 ms p99) control-plane overhead per HPC operation on a single-cluster prototype testbed.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF pp. 4–5 Section 5 & Tables 4–6 (Queue query p50/p95/p99 192/261/386 ms; Job submission 286/352/514 ms; Job cancel 242/318/472 ms; Storage access 214/297/446 ms).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Evaluasi prototipe ZT-OpenClaw-HPC pada empat operasi bidang kontrol Slurm menunjukkan tambahan latensi p50 yang terbatas sebesar 74–122 ms (total p50 192–286 ms, p95 261–352 ms, p99 386–514 ms pada Table 6) untuk verifikasi SVID, evaluasi PDP, dan pencatatan audit.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Pengukuran distribusi latensi p50/p95/p99 pada 4 kelas operasi bidang kontrol HPC dibandingkan terhadap baseline statis.
Protected_Object: Slurm HPC control-plane throughput and decision latency under Zero-Trust mediation
Composition_Evidence: Mengukur biaya kinerja kumulatif dari komposisi verifikasi SVID (B2), evaluasi kebijakan PDP (B3), dan penulisan log audit (B4) pada setiap aksi HPC.
Coding_Rationale: Dekomposisi Klaim Sekunder Reviewer 2 (CLM-E01-024B): Memisahkan klaim benchmark latensi kuantitatif bidang kontrol (RQ3 Table 6) dari klaim arsitektur pencegahan lintas-tenant ZT-OpenClaw-HPC (CLM-E01-024).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Pencatatan langsung distribusi p50/p95/p99 Table 6 pada sheet EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: IntentGuard: Securing MCP-Enabled LLM Agents via Post-Decision Semantic Plan Verification
Threat_Attacker_Model: Tool Metadata Poisoning in MCP servers inducing LLM agents to generate semantically misaligned yet syntactically valid tool-invocation plans and parameters.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Post-decision semantic plan verification framework (VISTA / IntentGuard) enforcing the Intention-Plan Consistency Paradigm via information isolation (minimal trusted context) and dual-dimension hierarchical semantic assessment (tool choice + parameter provenance).
Enforcement_Point_Location: Post-Decision / Pre-Execution Semantic Plan Verifier (VISTA) between Agent Planner and MCP Tool Executor
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Detects metadata-poisoned and intent-inconsistent MCP tool plans across 7 datasets in the MCPIntentEval benchmark, achieving 95.95%–99.53% accuracy and 94.95%–97.93% F1-score (up to +13.13% accuracy, +9.48% F1, and 90% fewer false positives over baselines, Table 1 p. 2).
Trust_Assumptions: User's original query is trusted; VISTA's isolated verification context is shielded from poisoned external tool metadata during provenance checking.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 1–2 (Table 1, Figures 1–2): across 7 MCPIntentEval datasets, VISTA achieves 95.95%–99.53% accuracy and 94.95%–97.93% F1-score while reducing false positives by up to 90% and adding bounded single-pass LLM verification time and token cost (Figure 2, p. 2).
Exposed_Security_Function: Context-isolated post-decision semantic plan verification and parameter provenance checking (VISTA)
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: 3-page Extended Abstract relying on an isolated LLM verifier call for semantic consistency (probabilistic rather than cryptographic/formal guarantee, AD) and evaluated on offline benchmark plans (UG).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract (IntentGuard / VISTA, MCPIntentEval, +13.13% accuracy, +9.48% F1, up to 90% fewer FPs); p. 2 Sections 2–3, Table 1 & Figures 1–2 (95.95%–99.53% accuracy, 94.95%–97.93% F1 across 7 datasets).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: IntentGuard (VISTA) memverifikasi konsistensi semantik antara niat pengguna dan rencana pemanggilan alat MCP pasca-keputusan menggunakan isolasi konteks dan validasi provenans parameter, mencapai F1 94,95%–97,93% di tujuh dataset MCPIntentEval serta memangkas positif palsu hingga 90%.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi pada 7 dataset dalam benchmark MCPIntentEval dibandingkan terhadap 4 baseline (MCP-Guard, MCIP, LLM-D, LLM-D+).
Protected_Object: MCP tool-invocation plans and tool parameter provenance against metadata poisoning
Composition_Evidence: Memvalidasi keselarasan rencana pemanggilan alat (B2;B3) terhadap kueri asli pengguna (B1) menggunakan konteks terisolasi yang bebas dari metadata beracun.
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (AAMAS'26 Extended Abstract) ini mengatasi keracunan metadata MCP melalui isolasi konteks verifikasi rencana pada B1;B2;B3. Diberi kode AD;UG karena verifikasi masih mengandalkan penilaian semantik berbasis LLM (AD) dan format Extended Abstract 3 halaman (UG).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan metrik Tabel 1 pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: Introducing Safe LLM-Agent Execution via Typed Tool Mediation and World-Effect Evaluation
Threat_Attacker_Model: Prompt-injected or misaligned tool-using LLM agents attempting unauthorized world effects (data deletion, protected-resource modification, secret exfiltration) across filesystem, database, and network channels.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Buildroot-based safe execution environment (AgentOS) combining a TLA+-modeled Verified Toolchain Reference Monitor (VTRM) enforcing capability-aware and label-aware typed tool mediation with a host-side World Effect Judge (WEJ) inspecting filesystem snapshots, DB diffs, audit logs, and network traffic.
Enforcement_Point_Location: OS/VM Execution Boundary (VTRM Reference Monitor) and Host-Side Post-Execution World Effect Judge (WEJ)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Fail-closed typed tool mediation and information-flow confidentiality (modeled and model-checked in TLA+): completes 21/24 benign tasks while blocking 48/48 (100%) evaluated harmful adversarial cases across two LLMs (Table 1, p. 2, 4).
Trust_Assumptions: Buildroot VM isolation boundary, VTRM reference monitor, and capability/confidentiality labels are trusted; out-of-band covert channels outside mediated tool interfaces are out of scope.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 2, 4 (Section 5, Table 1): across two LLMs, AgentOS completes 21/24 benign tasks (matching prompt-only and naive baselines) and blocks 48/48 (100%) harmful adversarial cases; runtime latency overhead in ms is NOT_REPORTED.
Exposed_Security_Function: Typed tool request mediation (VTRM), capability/label-aware policy enforcement, and host-side world-effect auditing (WEJ)
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Authors explicitly note (Section 3.2 p. 3 & Section 6 p. 4) that the TLA+ specification models the abstract VTRM decision path rather than a mechanized end-to-end refinement proof of the C/Python implementation, and the benchmark suite is compact (24 benign / 48 adversarial cases).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (AgentOS, VTRM modeled in TLA+, WEJ, 21/24 benign tasks completed, 48/48 harmful adversarial cases blocked); pp. 2–3 Section 3 & Figure 1 (VTRM & WEJ architecture, TLA+ scope note); p. 4 Section 5 & Table 1.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: AgentOS memediasi permintaan alat agen LLM melalui Verified Toolchain Reference Monitor (VTRM) yang dimodelkan dalam TLA+ serta mengevaluasi konsekuensi dunia nyata melalui World Effect Judge (WEJ), memblokir 48/48 (100%) kasus serangan berbahaya sambil menyelesaikan 21/24 tugas jinak.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Pemodelan jalur keputusan inti VTRM dalam TLA+ dan evaluasi eksperimental pada suite tugas jinak (24) dan adversarial (48) menggunakan dua LLM.
Protected_Object: Filesystem state, relational databases, outbound network channels, and host-observed world-effect audit logs
Composition_Evidence: Menggabungkan mediasi permintaan alat bertipe yang gagal-tertutup (fail-closed) sebelum eksekusi (B3) dengan pemeriksaan diferensial efek dunia nyata (snapshot FS, diff DB, log audit) di sisi host (B4).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (ASE'26) ini memadukan pemeriksaan model TLA+ pada VTRM (TOOL_SUPPORTED_VERIFICATION) dengan audit efek dunia nyata WEJ (B3;B4). Diberi kode AD;UG karena penulis secara jujur menyatakan model TLA+ belum berupa bukti penghalusan (refinement proof) ujung-ke-ujung terhadap implementasi (AD) dan ukuran suite uji masih terbatas (UG). Juga didekomposisi menjadi klaim sekunder (CLM-E01-026B) khusus untuk evaluator WEJ.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas cakupan verifikasi TLA+ dan dekomposisi VTRM/WEJ.

Study_Title: Introducing Safe LLM-Agent Execution via Typed Tool Mediation and World-Effect Evaluation
Threat_Attacker_Model: Unreliable or deceptive LLM self-reports claiming safe task completion while silently causing unauthorized filesystem mutations, database corruptions, or outbound network leaks.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Host-side World Effect Judge (WEJ) evaluating agent utility and safety from host-observed filesystem snapshots, relational database diffs, audit logs, and network packet captures.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Host-Side Post-Execution World Effect Judge (WEJ) outside the Guest Buildroot VM
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Provides ground-truth post-execution safety and utility evaluation independent of LLM text outputs by diffing host-observed filesystem, database, audit, and network states (Section 3.3 & Table 1, pp. 3–4).
Trust_Assumptions: Host-side snapshot/diff engine and network observer outside the guest VM cannot be tampered with by the guest agent.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 3–4 (Section 3.3 & Table 1): evaluates 24 benign tasks and 48 adversarial cases across two LLMs via host-side state diffs rather than model self-reports; latency in ms is NOT_REPORTED.
Exposed_Security_Function: Host-side filesystem snapshot diffing, database state diffing, and network/audit log verification (WEJ)
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Post-hoc evaluation judge designed for sandboxed VM testing suites (24 benign / 48 adversarial tasks) rather than live external third-party SaaS APIs where full database snapshots are unavailable.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan lokasi. PDF p. 1 Abstract & pp. 3–4 Section 3.3 / Table 1 (Host-side World Effect Judge WEJ measuring task completion and safety using filesystem snapshots, database diffs, audit logs, and network observations).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: World Effect Judge (WEJ) di sisi host menilai penyelesaian tugas dan keamanan agen secara objektif menggunakan snapshot sistem berkas, diff basis data, catatan audit, dan observasi jaringan tanpa bergantung pada laporan mandiri model.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi 24 tugas jinak dan 48 kasus adversarial pada lingkungan VM Buildroot AgentOS.
Protected_Object: Post-execution ground-truth auditability of filesystem, database, and network world effects
Composition_Evidence: Memverifikasi pada batas audit pasca-eksekusi (B4) bahwa mediasi VTRM pada batas eksekusi (B3) benar-benar tidak meninggalkan efek samping berbahaya di dunia nyata.
Coding_Rationale: Dekomposisi Klaim Sekunder Reviewer 2 (CLM-E01-026B): Memisahkan mekanisme audit diferensial sisi-host (WEJ pada B4) dari monitor referensi pra-eksekusi bertipe (VTRM pada B3).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas dekomposisi klaim WEJ (CLM-E01-026B).

Study_Title: Malice in Agentland: Down the Rabbit Hole of Backdoors in the AI Supply Chain
Threat_Attacker_Model: Supply-chain adversaries poisoning agent finetuning datasets (TM1), distributing pre-backdoored base models surviving clean SFT (TM2), or planting environment prompt-injection triggers during unsupervised agent trace collection (TM3) to implant persistent data-exfiltration backdoors.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Non-cryptographic supply-chain backdoor injection framework across three threat models (Direct SFT Poisoning, Backdoored Base Model, and Environment Poisoning) evaluated against 4 guardrail models and 1 weight-based defense.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Agent Finetuning Pipeline, Unsupervised Trace-Collection Environment, and Runtime Guardrail Filter
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Demonstrates that poisoning as few as 2.5% (100 samples) of finetuning traces implants backdoors achieving >80%–99.1% Attack Success Rate (ASR) on tau-Bench and WebArena-Lite while preserving benign Task Success Rate (TSR) and evading 4 guardrail models and weight-space defenses.
Trust_Assumptions: Agent developers collect interaction traces from external web/tool environments or finetune on third-party SFT datasets/base weights without cryptographic trajectory provenance or formally verified data sanitization.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 5–10 (Tables 1–3, Figures 3–4): across Qwen 2.5 (3B/7B) and Llama 3.1 on tau-Bench Retail (115 tasks) and WebArena-Lite (165 tasks), 2.5% direct poisoning yields 97.13%–99.1% ASR; environment poisoning (2.3%–5% injection rate) yields up to 41%–80%+ ASR; 4 guardrail models (Llama-Guard-3, ShieldGemma, Granite-Guardian, GPT-4o-mini) fail to prevent exfiltration.
Exposed_Security_Function: NOT_APPLICABLE — empirical study of supply-chain backdoor attacks (TM1–TM3) and guardrail evasion in finetuned AI agents
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Exposes a severe supply-chain vulnerability where runtime indirect prompt injections during data collection permanently bake into model weights as trigger-activated backdoors that evade both training-time screening and inference-time guardrails.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Figure 1 (TM1 direct poisoning, TM2 backdoored base model, TM3 environment poisoning, >80% ASR, evades 4 guardrails & 1 weight defense); p. 5 Table 1 (Experimental protocol on tau-Bench & WebArena-Lite); pp. 6–10 Section 5, Tables 2–3 & Figures 3–4 (97.13%–99.1% ASR at 2.5% poisoning).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Merumuskan tiga model ancaman pintu belakang (backdoor) rantai pasok agen AI—termasuk peracunan lingkungan saat pengumpulan trace tanpa pengawasan—yang mencapai ASR >80% hingga 99,1% pada tau-Bench dan WebArena-Lite serta melewati empat model guardrail dan pertahanan berbasis bobot.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi empiris lintas 3 model ancaman pada benchmark tau-Bench Retail (115 tugas) dan WebArena-Lite (165 tugas) beserta pengujian 5 mekanisme pertahanan.
Protected_Object: Agent finetuning datasets, model weights, and confidential user PII during tool/web execution
Composition_Evidence: Menunjukkan bagaimana injeksi lingkungan saat pengumpulan data (B1) terinternalisasi ke dalam kebijakan perencanaan model dan memicu pemanggilan API eksfiltrasi berbahaya saat runtime (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (CAIS'26) ini membuktikan kerentanan rantai pasok agenik dan kegagalan penjaga runtime maupun penyaringan data pelatihan (DG;AD) pada batas B1;B3.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas metrik ASR lintas TM1–TM3 (Tabel 1–3).

Study_Title: MalSkills: Detecting Malicious Skills in the Agentic Supply Chain via Neuro-symbolic Reasoning
Threat_Attacker_Model: Malicious agent skills distributed on public registries (e.g., ClawHub) distributing credential exfiltration, remote code execution, and agent-hijacking logic across heterogeneous artifacts (Markdown prompts, Python/JS scripts, YAML configs).
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Neuro-symbolic malicious skill detection framework (MalSkills) combining symbolic AST parsing and LLM-assisted semantic extraction to build a cross-artifact Skill Dependency Graph and execute Datalog-style neuro-symbolic reasoning rules.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Pre-Installation / Supply-Chain Skill Registry Scanner and Dependency Graph Reasoner
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Cross-artifact malicious workflow detection across prompt, code, and configuration files: achieves 0.93 F1-score (94% precision, 92% recall, 5% FPR) on the 200-skill MalSkillsBench benchmark, outperforming 5 existing scanners by 5–87 F1 percentage points (Table 3, p. 8).
Trust_Assumptions: Static/pre-installation skill package contents match the artifacts executed at runtime (remote dynamic payload fetching is flagged as a suspicious network-to-exec flow); underlying LLM semantic extractor operates within acceptable error bounds.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 2, 8–10 (Section 5, Tables 3–5): evaluated on MalSkillsBench (200 real-world skills: 100 malicious, 100 benign) against 5 baselines (VirusTotal, AgentGuard, Skill-Security-Scan, Cisco Skill-Scanner, Snyk Agent Scan); achieves 0.93 F1 (0.94 precision, 0.92 recall, 0.05 FPR) across LLM backbones (0.76–0.93 F1).
Exposed_Security_Function: Cross-artifact security-sensitive operation extraction, skill dependency graph construction, and neuro-symbolic rule reasoning
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Exhibits a 5% false positive rate and 8% false negative rate (0.92 recall, p. 8–9) when malicious logic relies on heavily obfuscated external binaries or novel semantic patterns not covered by the SSO taxonomy.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (MalSkills neuro-symbolic framework, 200-skill MalSkillsBench, 0.93 F1 outperforming 5 baselines by 5–87 pp); pp. 4–7 Section 4 & Figures 3–4 / Table 2 (SSO extraction & Skill Dependency Graph); pp. 7–10 Section 5 & Tables 3–5 (Precision 0.94, Recall 0.92, FPR 0.05, F1 0.93).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: MalSkills mendeteksi skill berbahaya dalam rantai pasok agenik dengan membangun graf ketergantungan lintas-artefak (prompt Markdown, kode, dan konfigurasi) serta menerapkan penalaran neuro-simbolik, mencapai skor F1 0,93 (presisi 0,94, recall 0,92, FPR 0,05) pada 200 skill dunia nyata dan mengungguli 5 alat pemindai mutakhir sebesar 5–87 poin F1.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi pada benchmark MalSkillsBench (200 skill dunia nyata) dibandingkan terhadap 5 pemindai komunitas/industri dan studi ablasi lintas model LLM.
Protected_Object: Agent skill supply chain packages, host credentials, and tool execution integrity
Composition_Evidence: Memodelkan komposisi aliran nilai dan operasi sensitif keamanan yang tersebar melintasi berkas prompt, konfigurasi, dan skrip eksekusi pada batas pemanggilan skill (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (ASE'26) ini mengatasi serangan lintas-artefak pada paket skill agen (B3) dengan penggabungan analisis simbolik AST dan ekstraksi semantik LLM. Diberi kode DG;AD karena masih terdapat 8% FN / 5% FP (DG) dan ketergantungan pada ekstraksi semantik LLM untuk berkas bahasa alami (AD).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas metrik MalSkillsBench (F1 0,93, FPR 0,05).

Study_Title: MCP-SecLint: An Open-Source Static Analyzer for Detecting Vulnerabilities in LLM Tool Integrations
Threat_Attacker_Model: Vulnerable JavaScript/TypeScript MCP server implementations exposing dangerous command execution sinks to untrusted LLM tool arguments, leaking authentication tokens to logs (token passthrough), or exposing unauthenticated HTTP/SSE endpoints.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Protocol-aware static taint analyzer and security linter (MCP-SecLint) combining TypeScript AST parsing, inter-procedural taint tracking from MCP tool schemas to shell/exec sinks, token-passthrough heuristics, and Express/HTTP middleware authentication checks.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Shift-Left Static Code Analyzer / CI/CD GitHub Code Scanning Pipeline (SARIF output)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Detects three classes of MCP server implementation vulnerabilities (command injection, token passthrough/logging, missing endpoint authentication) prior to deployment, uncovering 21 true-positive vulnerabilities across 5% of 100 public GitHub MCP server repositories (Tables 1–2, p. 7).
Trust_Assumptions: Server source code is available in JavaScript/TypeScript and follows standard MCP SDK registration patterns; dynamic runtime code loading (`eval` of remote strings) or non-JS servers are out of scope.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 7–8 (Section 6, Tables 1–3): scanned 100 public JS/TS MCP server repositories on GitHub, flagging 29 warnings across 9 repositories with 21 confirmed true positives across 5 vulnerable repositories (5% vulnerability rate; 72.4% precision: 9 token-passthrough, 7 missing-auth, 5 command-injection).
Exposed_Security_Function: Protocol-aware AST taint analysis, token-passthrough detection, and endpoint authentication linting (MCP-SecLint)
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Static analyzer limited to JavaScript/TypeScript MCP servers; exhibits 8 false positives out of 29 alerts (72.4% precision, Table 1 p. 7) and does not provide runtime enforcement against semantic prompt injection.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (MCP-SecLint, 3 analyzers, 100 GitHub MCP repositories, 5% vulnerability rate); pp. 3–6 Sections 4–5 & Figure 2 (AST + taint analysis design); pp. 7–8 Section 6 & Tables 1–3 (29 alerts, 21 true positives across 5 repos, 9 token-passthrough, 7 missing-auth, 5 command-injection).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: MCP-SecLint melakukan analisis taint statis sadar-protokol pada kode sumber server MCP JavaScript/TypeScript untuk mendeteksi eksekusi perintah berbahaya, kebocoran token (token passthrough), dan endpoint tanpa autentikasi, menemukan 21 kerentanan positif-benar pada 5% dari 100 repositori server MCP publik di GitHub.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi ekosistem empiris pada 100 repositori server MCP JavaScript/TypeScript publik di GitHub dengan verifikasi manual positif-benar/positif-palsu.
Protected_Object: MCP server command execution sinks, API/OAuth tokens, and HTTP/SSE server endpoints
Composition_Evidence: Melacak aliran argumen alat MCP yang tidak tepercaya menuju sink sistem operasi dan kebocoran token pada batas implementasi server alat (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (IWSPA'26) ini menyediakan pemindai statis sumber terbuka untuk implementasi server MCP pada B3 dan melaporkan hasil audit 100 repositori (Tabel 1–3, p. 7–8). Diberi kode DG;AD karena tingkat positif palsu 8/29 dan cakupan terbatas pada analisis statis JS/TS tanpa pencegahan runtime.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas rincian 21 TP pada Tabel 1–2.

Study_Title: Mind the Web: The Security of Web Use Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Third-party web content adversaries embedding 'task-aligned' indirect prompt injections in public comments, reviews, or advertisements to hijack web-use agents across Confidentiality (camera activation, local file/credential exfiltration), Integrity (unauthorized actions, phishing), and Availability (task abortion/DoS).
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Automated three-stage RL-trained injection generator (candidate generation, offline judge filtering, and two-stage SFT + DPO/RL fine-tuning) producing task-aligned adversarial web payloads.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Web-Use Agent DOM/Visual Content Ingestion and Task-Planning Loop
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Demonstrates that RL-tuned task-aligned web injections achieve >80% overall Attack Success Rate (82% average ASR, 79%–85% per payload across P1–P9) across 5 production web-use agents (OpenAI Operator, Browser Use, Do Browser, OpenOperator, Perplexity Comet) with strong cross-model and cross-site transferability (Table 1, p. 5).
Trust_Assumptions: Attacker only requires standard user privileges to post public user-generated content (comments/reviews) on legitimate websites visited by the victim's authenticated web-use agent.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 1–2, 5–7 (Section 5.4, Table 1): across 5 web-use agents and 9 CIA payload classes (100 independent runs per experiment), naive non-aligned injection achieves 12% ASR, untuned task-aligned injection achieves 54% ASR, and the two-stage RL-tuned generator achieves 82% overall ASR (individual payloads 79%–85% ASR, e.g., Local File Exfiltration 84%, Task Abortion 84%, Phishing 81%).
Exposed_Security_Function: NOT_APPLICABLE — automated RL-tuned task-aligned indirect prompt injection attack framework against web-use agents
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Reveals that framing malicious commands as helpful task-completion steps bypasses existing LLM safety alignment and browser-agent guardrails across all five commercial/open-source web agents.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (>80% ASR across 5 agents: OpenAI Operator, Browser Use, Do Browser, OpenOperator, Perplexity Comet; 79%–85% per payload); pp. 3–5 Section 5 & Figure 1 / Table 1 (12% naive vs 54% untuned vs 82% RL-tuned ASR; P1–P9 CIA payloads).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Teknik injeksi prompt tidak langsung yang diselaraskan dengan tugas (task-aligned) dan dilatih melalui pipeline tiga-tahap mencapai rata-rata ASR 82% (79%–85% di 9 muatan CIA termasuk eksfiltrasi berkas lokal dan pengaktifan kamera) pada lima agen web populer (OpenAI Operator, Browser Use, Do Browser, OpenOperator, Perplexity Comet).
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi empiris lintas 5 agen penggunaan web populer dan 9 kategori muatan serangan CIA (masing-masing 100 run per eksperimen) beserta uji transferabilitas.
Protected_Object: Authenticated browser sessions, local files, device peripherals (camera), and user task integrity
Composition_Evidence: Menunjukkan bagaimana konten pihak ketiga yang tampak membantu saat ingesti halaman web (B1) membajak penalaran agen untuk mengeksekusi aksi peramban dan sistem berkas berisiko tinggi (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (ASIA CCS'26) ini membuktikan kerentanan parah agen web komersial dan sumber terbuka pada batas B1;B3 terhadap injeksi konten yang diselaraskan dengan tugas (DG;AD).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas angka ASR Tabel 1 (12% -> 54% -> 82%).

Study_Title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) at First Glance: Studying the Security and Maintainability of MCP Servers
Threat_Attacker_Model: Software vulnerabilities (credential exposure, command injection, path traversal, SSRF) and MCP-specific tool poisoning embedded in open-source MCP server repositories.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Large-scale empirical ecosystem analysis pipeline combining general static analysis (SonarQube) and MCP-specific tool-poisoning scanning (MCP-Scan) across 1,899 open-source MCP servers.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Offline Ecosystem Repository Analysis Pipeline (SonarQube + MCP-Scan across 1,899 MCP servers)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Characterizes the security and maintainability landscape of 1,899 open-source MCP servers: identifies 8 distinct vulnerability categories (only 3 overlapping with traditional software vulnerabilities), finding that 7.2% of servers contain general software vulnerabilities, 5.5% exhibit MCP-specific tool poisoning, 66% exhibit code smells, and 14.4% contain bug patterns.
Trust_Assumptions: Developers and enterprise users integrate open-source MCP servers from public registries assuming benign tool descriptions and secure server implementations.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 4, 15–35 (Tables 1–8): across 1,899 open-source MCP servers, 7.2% contain general vulnerabilities (with credential exposure being most prevalent), 5.5% exhibit MCP-specific tool poisoning, 66.0% contain code smells, and 14.4% contain bug patterns; scanning per project took seconds to 5 minutes (completed within 4 days, p. 17).
Exposed_Security_Function: NOT_APPLICABLE — empirical ecosystem study of security vulnerabilities and maintainability across 1,899 MCP servers
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Demonstrates that traditional static analyzers (SonarQube) miss MCP-specific tool poisoning (5.5% of servers), while MCP-specific scanners miss general code vulnerabilities (7.2% of servers).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 4 Section 1 (1,899 open-source MCP servers evaluated, 8 distinct vulnerability types, 7.2% general vulnerabilities, 5.5% MCP-specific tool poisoning, 66% code smells, 14.4% bugs); pp. 13–17 Section 4 & Fig. 4 / Table 1 (Study design); pp. 24–36 Section 5 (RQ2 Security & RQ3 Maintainability results).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Studi empiris skala besar pertama terhadap 1.899 server MCP sumber terbuka mengidentifikasi delapan kategori kerentanan berbeda, di mana 7,2% server mengandung kerentanan perangkat lunak umum dan 5,5% menunjukkan keracunan alat (tool poisoning) spesifik-MCP.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi kesehatan proyek, keamanan (SonarQube + MCP-Scan), dan keterawatan kode pada 1.899 repositori server MCP sumber terbuka.
Protected_Object: Open-source MCP server implementations, tool metadata descriptions, and host integration interfaces
Composition_Evidence: Memetakan permukaan kerentanan ganda pada batas server MCP (B3), yaitu kerentanan kode tradisional dan injeksi deskripsi alat (tool poisoning).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (TOSEM'26, 53 hlm.) ini memberikan bukti empiris komprehensif atas lanskap kerentanan 1.899 server MCP pada B3 dengan kode limitasi DG;AD.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas statistik 1.899 server (7,2% umum, 5,5% tool poisoning).

Study_Title: Not What You've Signed Up For: Compromising Real-World LLM-Integrated Applications with Indirect Prompt Injection
Threat_Attacker_Model: Remote adversaries strategically planting Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) payloads into external data sources (webpages, emails, documents, code repositories) retrieved at inference time by LLM-integrated applications.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Non-cryptographic Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) taxonomy and Proof-of-Concept exploit suite (information gathering/exfiltration, fraud/phishing, malware/worming, intrusion/remote control, content manipulation, availability DoS).
Enforcement_Point_Location: LLM-Integrated Application Retrieval Ingestion Interface and Downstream API/Tool Calling Layer
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Establishes the foundational Indirect Prompt Injection threat taxonomy and demonstrates practical remote compromise across real-world deployed systems (Bing Chat, Github Copilot / code-completion engines) and GPT-4 synthetic tool-integrated applications.
Trust_Assumptions: LLM-integrated application concatenates untrusted retrieved external data with trusted system/user instructions in a shared context window and grants the model authority to invoke external APIs or render markdown/links.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: Qualitative Proof-of-Concept attack demonstrations across 6 threat categories on Bing Chat, code-completion engines, and GPT-4 synthetic apps (Section 4, pp. 5–9); numerical ASR or latency overhead in ms is NOT_REPORTED.
Exposed_Security_Function: NOT_APPLICABLE — foundational offensive taxonomy and Proof-of-Concept demonstration of Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI)
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Demonstrates that blurring data and instruction channels in retrieval-augmented and tool-using LLMs creates a fundamental architectural vulnerability without deterministic privilege separation.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan lokasi. PDF p. 1 Abstract; pp. 2–5 Section 3 & Figures 2–3 (Indirect Prompt Injection Threat Model & Taxonomy); pp. 5–9 Section 4 & Figures 4–9 (Proof-of-Concept demonstrations on Bing Chat, code completion, and GPT-4 apps across 6 threat classes).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Merumuskan taksonomi serangan Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) dan mendemonstrasikan melalui bukti konsep pada sistem dunia nyata (Bing Chat, mesin pelengkap kode, dan aplikasi terintegrasi GPT-4) bahwa data eksternal yang diambil saat inferensi dapat membajak kendali aplikasi dan memicu pemanggilan API berbahaya.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Taksonomi keamanan komputer untuk IPI dan demonstrasi Proof-of-Concept kualitatif pada Bing Chat, mesin pelengkap kode, dan aplikasi sintetis GPT-4.
Protected_Object: LLM instruction-data boundary, user session data, and connected application APIs
Composition_Evidence: Menunjukkan secara langsung bagaimana pencampuran data eksternal tak tepercaya dengan instruksi sistem pada saat ingesti (B1) bermuara pada eksekusi API/alat yang dikendalikan penyerang (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi fondasional Stream A (AISec'23, Greshake et al.) ini memetakan permukaan serangan IPI lintas B1;B3 dengan bukti konsep nyata (PROOF_OF_CONCEPT) dan kode limitasi DG;AD.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas klasifikasi PROOF_OF_CONCEPT dan cakupan taksonomi IPI.

Study_Title: OPENCLAW-SRT: Resource-Aware Autonomous Agent Architecture for Smart City Edge Computing
Threat_Attacker_Model: Indirect prompt injection, supply-chain command injection, SSH key theft, and reverse-shell attacks targeting full-permission edge AI agents (OpenClaw) in smart-city IoT management.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Three-layer edge agent security architecture (OpenClaw-SRT): (1) Semantic Routing Layer (Llama 3.2 1B/3B + MiniLM-L6-v2 semantic cache), (2) Zero-Trust Privacy Gateway Layer (regex/NER PII masking + deterministic AST/command verification), and (3) Security Sandbox Layer (Docker container isolation with privilege grading).
Enforcement_Point_Location: Edge Semantic Router, Pre-Inference Zero-Trust Privacy Gateway, and Docker Container Execution Sandbox
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Reduces cloud API token consumption by 85% (cutting monthly cost from ~$1,000 to <$120) while intercepting 99.2% of supply-chain/prompt-injection attacks and reducing SSH key theft ASR from 96% to 0% in smart-city IoT scenarios (Table 3, pp. 3–4).
Trust_Assumptions: Local edge node hardware (RTX 4060 / Jetson), deterministic privacy gateway rules, and Docker container runtime are uncompromised.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 1–4 (Sections 3–4, Tables 2–3, Figures 2–3): semantic routing encoding latency is <5 ms on RTX 4060 (vs 300–800 ms cloud API RTT); reduces cloud token consumption by 85% and monthly cost from $1,000 to <$120 with only 0.4% task accuracy drop while intercepting 99.2% of supply-chain attacks (blocking 96% baseline SSH key theft).
Exposed_Security_Function: Complexity-based edge-cloud semantic routing, PII desensitization, deterministic command verification, and graded Docker sandboxing
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Compact 5-page conference paper where deterministic command verification relies on static rule patterns and container privilege tiers; evaluated on simulated smart-city IoT management workloads.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract (85% cloud token reduction, cost <$120/mo vs $1,000, 99.2% supply-chain attack interception); pp. 2–3 Section 3 & Figure 1 / Table 1 (<5 ms MiniLM encoding latency vs 300–800 ms API RTT); pp. 3–4 Section 4 & Tables 2–3 (0.4% accuracy drop, 96% baseline SSH key theft blocked).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: OpenClaw-SRT menerapkan arsitektur keamanan tiga-lapis (Semantic Routing, Zero-Trust Privacy Gateway, dan Docker Security Sandbox) untuk agen otonom di edge smart city, memangkas konsumsi token cloud sebesar 85% (biaya <$120/bulan) dengan latensi pengkodean <5 ms serta mencegat 99,2% serangan rantai pasok/injeksi.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi eksperimental pada skenario manajemen perangkat IoT smart city dengan perbandingan biaya, akurasi, dan intersepsi serangan terhadap baseline OpenClaw.
Protected_Object: Edge IoT device credentials (SSH keys), citizen PII, and edge host execution environment
Composition_Evidence: Menggabungkan perutean semantik dan masking PII sebelum inferensi cloud (B1) dengan verifikasi perintah deterministik dan isolasi kontainer Docker saat eksekusi alat lokal (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (SCSD'26) ini menyajikan arsitektur pertahanan tiga-lapis untuk OpenClaw dengan metrik biaya, latensi (<5 ms), dan intersepsi serangan (99,2%) yang terukur pada batas B1;B3. Diberi kode AD;UG karena ketergantungan pada aturan deterministik statis/Docker (AD) dan cakupan skenario simulasi smart-city yang ringkas (UG).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan metrik Tabel 3 (<5 ms, 85% penghematan token, 99,2% intersepsi) pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: Privacy Risks and Leakage Pathways in Agentic and Multi-Agent AI Systems
Threat_Attacker_Model: Internal curious/compromised agents and external adversaries exploiting five structural privacy leakage pathways in multi-agent systems: (1) autonomy-induced overexposure, (2) coordination-driven propagation, (3) memory/persistent-state leakage, (4) emergent compositional inference, and (5) observability/audit trace leakage.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Hybrid Dec-POMDP and trace-based information-flow formal model coupled with a multi-agent privacy sandbox enforcing policy-checked privacy-aware mediation across agent observations, inter-agent messages, memory, tool calls, and audit logs.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Inter-Agent Message Mediator, Persistent Memory Controller, Tool-Call Policy Gate, and Audit Trace Redactor
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Formalizes multi-agent privacy leakage as adversarial trace-projection inference advantage over Dec-POMDP executions and empirically reduces leakage across 5 benchmark-style privacy families (achieving 98.2%–98.9% policy compliance and near-zero direct leakage under `privacy_aware + policy_checked` while preserving 1.00–1.02 relative task success, Table 3 pp. 17–18).
Trust_Assumptions: Policy-checking reference monitor and trace sanitizer are trusted; single local instruction-tuned LLM used in sandbox validation.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 16–19 (Section 6, Tables 3–4, Figures 2–4): across all 5 benchmark-style privacy families (ConfAIde, PrivacyLens, PrivaCI, etc.), `privacy_aware + policy_checked` reduces adversarial inference advantage from 0.4900 to 0.0054–0.0090 (98.2%–98.9% reduction) while maintaining task success rate; residual leakage remains in indirect compositional/observability channels (Table 4, p. 18).
Exposed_Security_Function: Trace-based information-flow policy checking, inter-agent message minimization, memory retention control, and audit trace sanitization
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Table 4 & Figure 3 (p. 18) explicitly document non-zero residual leakage through emergent compositional inference across multiple benign messages and observability/timing side channels; Section 6.6 (p. 19) notes validation used a single local LLM.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract (five leakage pathways, Dec-POMDP + trace semantics); pp. 5–11 Sections 3–5 & Figure 1 (Formal Hybrid Dec-POMDP & Trace Model); pp. 12–19 Section 6, Tables 2–4 & Figures 2–4 (Sandbox evaluation across 5 privacy families, inference advantage reduced from 0.4900 to 0.0054–0.0090, residual channels in Table 4).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Menyintesis lima jalur kebocoran privasi struktural pada sistem AI multi-agen menggunakan abstraksi formal gabungan Dec-POMDP dan semantik aliran informasi berbasis trace, serta memvalidasi melalui sandbox multi-agen bahwa mediasi sadar-kebijakan memangkas keunggulan inferensi lawan dari 0,4900 menjadi 0,0054–0,0090 namun menyisakan saluran kebocoran komposisional dan observabilitas.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Pemodelan formal Dec-POMDP berbasis trace, analisis kesenjangan PET tradisional, dan evaluasi sandbox terkontrol pada 5 keluarga benchmark privasi.
Protected_Object: Sensitive user/patient attributes across inter-agent messages, persistent agent memory, tool calls, and audit logs
Composition_Evidence: Secara eksplisit memodelkan dan mengukur kebocoran komposisional lintas keempat batas (B1;B2;B3;B4), membuktikan bahwa pesan-pesan yang aman secara individual dapat bocor saat dikomposisikan lintas agen dan log audit (Table 4, p. 18).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (ACM TOPS'26, 36 hlm.) ini sangat penting untuk RQ1 dan RQ2 karena memformalkan komposisi kebocoran lintas B1;B2;B3;B4 dan membuktikan secara kuantitatif adanya kebocoran residu komposisional dan audit (DG;AD).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas pemetaan B1;B2;B3;B4 dan angka Tabel 3–4.

Study_Title: PromptShield: Deployable Detection for Prompt Injection Attacks
Threat_Attacker_Model: Direct and indirect prompt injection attacks embedded in conversational user inputs or application-structured data attempting to hijack LLM-integrated applications.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Curated 29,405-sample PromptShield benchmark (conversational + application-structured splits) and fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B / DeBERTa prompt injection detector calibrated for ultra-low false positive rate (0.1%–1% FPR) deployment.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Pre-Inference Prompt Ingestion Detection Gateway (PromptShield Classifier with Output Score Caching)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: High-recall prompt injection detection in the deployable low-FPR regime: achieves 65.3% True Positive Rate (TPR) at 0.1% FPR (and 88.2% TPR at 1.0% FPR, Area Under ROC 0.990) on the PromptShield evaluation split, compared to only 9.4% TPR at 0.1% FPR for the best prior detector (PromptGuard, Figure 2 & Table 4 pp. 2, 9).
Trust_Assumptions: System prompt/application template structure is known to the detector; pre-inference gateway cannot be bypassed by direct model calls.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 2, 6–9 (Figure 2, Tables 2–4): evaluated on 29,405 total samples (23,599 train / 5,806 test across conversational and application-structured data); PromptShield-Llama-3.1-8B achieves 65.3% TPR at 0.1% FPR and 88.2% TPR at 1.0% FPR (vs 9.4% TPR at 0.1% FPR for PromptGuard), and reduces end-to-end attack success rate (ASR) on 200 crafted attacks (Appendix Table 11, p. 14). Explicit latency in ms is NOT_REPORTED in the PDF (calibrated from pilot template).
Exposed_Security_Function: Low-FPR fine-tuned prompt injection classification and threshold-calibrated request filtering
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: At the strict 0.1% FPR threshold required for production deployment, 34.7% of prompt injections still evade detection (65.3% TPR, Table 4 p. 9), and smaller models (DeBERTa-v3-large) drop to 19.3% TPR at 0.1% FPR; adaptive white-box optimization attacks remain out of scope (Section 2.3 p. 3 & Section 5 p. 10).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan audit langsung PDF ter-pin. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Figure 2 (65.3% TPR at 0.1% FPR vs 9.4% prior best); pp. 4–7 Section 3 & Tables 1–2 / Figure 3 (PromptShield benchmark 23,599 train / 5,806 eval samples & deployment scheme); pp. 8–9 Section 4 & Tables 3–4 (65.3% TPR @ 0.1% FPR, 88.2% TPR @ 1% FPR, 0.990 AUC).
