Study_Title: Red-Teaming Coding Agents from a Tool-Invocation Perspective: An Empirical Security Assessment
Threat_Attacker_Model: Two-phase red-teaming adversary targeting real-world IDE coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Trae): Phase 1 exploits a 'mode gap' in schema-driven tool-argument completion (ToolLeak) to exfiltrate confidential system prompts/tool schemas, and Phase 2 uses leaked internals to craft two-channel prompt injections achieving Remote Code Execution (RCE).
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Two-phase tool-invocation red-teaming framework combining schema-driven tool-argument prompt exfiltration (ToolLeak) with adaptive two-channel tool-invocation hijacking (RCE-1 / RCE-2).
Enforcement_Point_Location: Coding Agent Tool-Call Argument Generation Interface and IDE Command Execution Harness
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Demonstrates a structural 'mode gap' between chat generation and tool-argument completion: ToolLeak achieves the highest system-prompt pseudo-recall on 18/25 real-world coding agent-LLM pairs (reaching 1.00 on Cursor and Claude Code, Table 4 p. 13), and adaptive Phase 2 payloads hijack all 6 commercial coding agents for RCE with 0.8–1.0 ASR across most configurations (Table 5 p. 15).
Trust_Assumptions: Attacker can supply untrusted prompt inputs or repository files/MCP tool descriptions processed by the victim's IDE coding agent.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 2–3, 11–16 (Tables 3–5): across 6 commercial coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Trae) and 25 agent-LLM configurations, ToolLeak achieves best pseudo-recall in 18/25 pairs (up to 1.00 vs 0.00 for naive baselines), and Phase 2 RCE-2 achieves 80%–100% (0.8–1.0) attack success rate across all 6 agents.
Exposed_Security_Function: NOT_APPLICABLE — empirical red-teaming framework (ToolLeak + adaptive RCE hijacking) against commercial coding agents
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Proves that safety alignment trained primarily on conversational chat outputs fails during structured JSON/schema tool-argument generation ('mode gap'), enabling both confidential prompt extraction and arbitrary command execution in production IDEs.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (6 real-world coding agents: Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Trae; ToolLeak mode gap; best pseudo-recall on 18/25 pairs; RCE across all 6 agents); pp. 5–9 Sections 4–5 & Figures 1–2 / Table 1; pp. 11–16 Section 6 & Tables 3–5 (pseudo-recall up to 1.00, RCE ASR 0.8–1.0).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Mengeksploitasi kesenjangan mode (mode gap) antara pembuatan obrolan dan pengisian argumen pemanggilan alat melalui ToolLeak untuk mengekstrak prompt sistem rahasia (unggul pada 18 dari 25 pasangan agen-LLM) dan membajak keenam agen pengkodean komersial (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Trae) hingga mencapai Remote Code Execution (RCE) dengan ASR 80%–100%.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi red-teaming dua fase pada 6 agen pengkodean tersimulasi dan 6 agen pengkodean IDE komersial dunia nyata lintas 25 konfigurasi model LLM.
Protected_Object: Coding agent confidential system prompts, built-in tool schemas, and host OS command execution boundary
Composition_Evidence: Menunjukkan komposisi serangan dua-tahap: kebocoran spesifikasi internal melalui pembuatan argumen alat (B3) digunakan untuk merakit injeksi dua-kanal (B1) yang memicu RCE penuh pada host (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (Proc. ACM Softw. Eng. 2026) ini mendemonstrasikan kerentanan dunia nyata pada 6 IDE agenik populer (DEPLOYMENT_LIKE_EVALUATION) di batas B1;B3 dengan kode DG;AD.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas metrik Tabel 4 (18/25 pasangan) dan Tabel 5 (0,8–1,0 RCE ASR).

Study_Title: Safeguarding LLM Agents from Misalignment through Provenance Analysis
Threat_Attacker_Model: Misaligned or prompt-injected tool invocations exhibiting three classes of misalignment: (1) tool-level misalignment (wrong tool), (2) parameter-level misalignment (untraceable/fabricated parameters), and (3) interpretation-level misalignment (arbitrary resolution of underspecified user intent).
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Three-stage provenance-based runtime guardrail (ProvenanceGuard) formalizing predicate provenance relations over user request, tool documentation, and interaction history to verify tool choice, parameter assignment, and query interpretation before execution.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Pre-Execution Runtime Guardrail Monitor (ProvenanceGuard Three-Stage Pipeline)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Traceable provenance alignment for every proposed tool call: reduces error rate on misaligned traces from 44.3% to 2.1% on Agent-SafetyBench and from 32.4% to 18.7% on WorkBench across 11 LLMs, while cutting unnecessary interventions on task-successful traces from 31.2% to 13.0% (Tables 2–3, p. 1, 10).
Trust_Assumptions: User's initial query and tool documentation are trusted; the LLM-assisted natural-language provenance predicate evaluator operates faithfully on isolated context segments.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 2, 9–10 (Section 6, Tables 2–3, Figure 4): across 11 backbone LLMs on Agent-SafetyBench and WorkBench, ProvenanceGuard reduces misaligned error rate from 44.3% to 2.1% (Agent-SafetyBench) and 32.4% to 18.7% (WorkBench), reduces false interventions from 31.2% to 13.0%, and incurs bounded multi-stage LLM query token and wall-clock latency (~10–30 s per case in Figure 4c, p. 10).
Exposed_Security_Function: Three-stage provenance relation verification (Tool-Level, Parameter-Level, and Interpretation-Level alignment checks)
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Still leaves an 18.7% error rate on misaligned WorkBench traces and a 13.0% unnecessary intervention rate on successful traces (Tables 2–3, p. 10) because natural-language provenance entailment predicates are evaluated by an LLM.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (3 types of misalignment Fig. 1; error rate reduced from 44.3% to 2.1% on Agent-SafetyBench and 32.4% to 18.7% on WorkBench; interventions reduced from 31.2% to 13.0%); pp. 4–6 Section 4 & Table 1 / Fig. 3 (Provenance Relations & 3-stage pipeline); pp. 9–10 Section 6, Tables 2–3 & Fig. 4.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: ProvenanceGuard memformalkan deteksi ketidaksejajaran (misalignment) pemanggilan alat sebagai analisis provenans tiga-tahap (pemilihan alat, penugasan parameter, dan interpretasi kueri), menurunkan tingkat kesalahan pada trace tidak sejajar dari 44,3% menjadi 2,1% di Agent-SafetyBench dan dari 32,4% menjadi 18,7% di WorkBench lintas 11 LLM.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi pada benchmark Agent-SafetyBench dan WorkBench lintas 11 model LLM dibandingkan terhadap baseline LLM-as-a-judge (DirectPrompt dan ProvePrompt).
Protected_Object: Tool selection alignment, tool parameter provenance, and user query interpretation fidelity
Composition_Evidence: Menghubungkan bukti yang dapat dilacak pada konteks permintaan pengguna (B1) dengan validasi pra-eksekusi atas pemilihan alat dan argumennya (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (ASE'26) ini memformalkan relasi provenans predikat (Table 1, p. 5) dan mengevaluasi trade-off keamanan vs intervensi/latensi pada 11 LLM (B1;B3). Diberi kode DG;AD karena residu kesalahan 18,7% pada WorkBench (DG) dan ketergantungan pada evaluasi predikat bahasa alami menggunakan LLM (AD).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan metrik Tabel 2–3 & Gambar 4 pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: SBOMs into Agentic AIBOMs: Schema Extensions, Agentic Orchestration and Reproducibility Evaluation
Threat_Attacker_Model: Dynamic runtime environment drift, uncaptured transitive dependencies, and static SBOM blind spots that obscure real-time exploitability and provenance in autonomous multi-agent AI supply chains.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Standards-aligned Agentic AIBOM schema (extending SPDX/CycloneDX and ISO/IEC 20153:2025 CSAF v2.0 / VEX) orchestrated across multi-agent protocols (MCP, A2A, AGNTCY) to emit cryptographically hashed and signed runtime provenance snapshots.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Multi-Agent Runtime Telemetry Collector and SBOM-VEX Provenance Attestation Pipeline (Pre/Mid/Post Execution Snapshots)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Captures dynamic runtime dependency graphs, execution context, and contextual VEX exploitability assertions into a cryptographically verifiable AIBOM object, achieving 98.6% dependency/reproducibility fidelity across pre/mid/post execution snapshots (Table 1, pp. 23–26).
Trust_Assumptions: Host container telemetry hooks, hash/signature keys, and vulnerability knowledge bases (CVE/VEX feeds) are uncompromised and synchronized.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 23–26 (Table 1 & Section 4): achieves 98.6% reproducibility and dependency capture fidelity across pre/mid/post snapshots while maintaining low system resource overhead of ~4% CPU (<4% CPU) and under 300 MB RAM, outperforming ReproZip, SciUnit, and ProvStore.
Exposed_Security_Function: Cryptographically hashed/signed dynamic AIBOM snapshot generation and contextual CSAF/VEX exploitability attestation
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Compliance mapping degrades partially in legacy build pipelines without fine-grained runtime instrumentation (p. 18); relies on honest host telemetry collection and pre-quantum cryptographic hashing/signing.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan audit langsung PDF ter-pin. PDF p. 2 Abstract & pp. 3–4 Section 1 (MCP, A2A, AGNTCY agentic orchestration, cryptographically verifiable provenance object); pp. 8–17 Section 3 & Figures 1–3 (Formalising Agentic Components, ISO/IEC 20153:2025 CSAF v2.0 & Agentic AIBOM Schema); pp. 23–26 Table 1 & Results (98.6% fidelity, <4% CPU, <300 MB RAM vs ReproZip/SciUnit/ProvStore).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Memperluas SBOM statis menjadi Agentic AIBOM dinamis yang terintegrasi dengan standar ISO/IEC 20153:2025 CSAF v2.0/VEX melalui orkestrasi multi-agen (MCP, A2A, AGNTCY), mencapai fidelitas reproduktifitas 98,6% dengan overhead sistem rendah (<4% CPU dan <300 MB RAM).
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Diaudit ulang oleh Reviewer 2 dari PDF SCR-0408_ACM-S-0076.pdf (ACM DTRAP, 36 hlm.): pemodelan skema formal AIBOM/VEX dan evaluasi benchmark terhadap ReproZip, SciUnit, dan ProvStore.
Protected_Object: Runtime software/model dependencies, execution environment state snapshots, and VEX vulnerability exploitability attestations
Composition_Evidence: Mengikat telemetri pemanggilan alat dan dependensi saat eksekusi (B3) ke dalam objek provenans AIBOM/VEX yang dapat diaudit secara kriptografis (B4).
Coding_Rationale: Audit & Penyempurnaan Reviewer 2 atas draf pilot CLM-0027: Mengubah Target_Boundary menjadi MULTI_BOUNDARY (selaras dengan Boundary_Codes `B3;B4`) dan menambahkan metrik kuantitatif eksak dari Table 1 (pp. 23–26: fidelitas 98,6%, overhead <4% CPU dan <300 MB RAM dibandingkan ReproZip, SciUnit, dan ProvStore).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas penyelarasan MULTI_BOUNDARY (B3;B4) dan metrik Table 1 (98,6% fidelitas, <4% CPU, <300 MB RAM).

Study_Title: Scene-Conditioned Capability Mounting as a Visible and Executable Boundary for Situated LLM Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Cross-scene capability overexposure and prompt-contaminated cross-scene tool invocations or memory reads in situated mobile/smart-environment LLM assistants.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Two-layer Scene-Conditioned Capability Mounting architecture: Layer 1 dynamically unmounts stale scene tools/memory schemas from the planner prompt upon physical scene transitions, and Layer 2 enforces independent deterministic runtime gates on tool calls and memory reads with UI boundary cues.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Pre-Planning Capability Mounter (Layer 1) and Runtime Tool/Memory Execution Gate (Layer 2)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Reduces planner tool-schema prompt footprint by ~57% (from 676 to 288–289 estimated token equivalents) and achieves 0 completed cross-scene actions across 520 contaminated runs and 0 cross-scene memory returns across 1,200 read-side runs within the evaluated threat model (Section 4, pp. 1, 5–6).
Trust_Assumptions: Physical scene resolution (e.g., BLE/sensor state machine) and the host-side runtime gate are trusted and unbypassable by the LLM planner.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 1, 4–6 (Section 4, Tables 1–2, Figures 3–4): dynamic capability mounting reduces tool-schema prompt size by ~57% (from 676 to 288–289 token equivalents); runtime gates block 100% of cross-scene actions (0/520 contaminated runs) and 100% of cross-scene memory reads (0/1,200 runs); validated in a 24-participant prototype user study.
Exposed_Security_Function: Scene-conditioned pre-planning tool/memory mounting and deterministic runtime cross-scene access gating
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Evaluated in a two-scene controlled benchmark and scripted BLE prototype study (UG); relies on accurate physical scene detection/grounding and notes that user recovery/repair actions after blocked boundary cues remained unclear in several interview cases (p. 1, 6–8).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract (tool-schema prompt reduced from 676 to 288–289 token equivalents ~57%, 0 cross-scene actions in 520 contaminated runs, 0 cross-scene memory returns in 1,200 runs, 24-participant study); pp. 2–5 Section 3 & Figure 1 / Table 1; pp. 5–7 Section 4 & Table 2 / Figures 3–4.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Pemasangan kapabilitas terkondisi-adegan (scene-conditioned capability mounting) menghapus skema alat dan memori yang tidak relevan sebelum perencanaan (memangkas ukuran prompt skema alat sebesar ~57% dari 676 menjadi 288–289 ekuivalen token) dan menegakkan gerbang runtime independen yang menghasilkan nol aksi lintas-adegan pada 520 run terkontaminasi serta nol pembacaan memori lintas-adegan pada 1.200 run.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Benchmark terkontrol dua-adegan (520 run aksi terkontaminasi dan 1.200 run pembacaan memori) serta studi purwarupa formatif 24 partisipan dengan telemetri BLE.
Protected_Object: Scene-scoped smart-environment tools and private situational memory stores
Composition_Evidence: Memisahkan pengurangan eksposur kapabilitas saat perencanaan (B2) dari gerbang otorisasi deterministik saat pemanggilan alat dan pembacaan memori (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (ICMI'26) ini secara bersih memisahkan efek penyempitan skema perencana (B2) dan gerbang eksekusi runtime (B3) dengan penghematan token ~57% dan blokir 100% dalam cakupan uji. Diberi kode AD;UG karena asumsi kebenaran resolusi sensor adegan fisik (AD) dan pengujian terbatas pada prototipe dua-adegan (UG).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan penghematan token 57% pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: Securing the Last Mile of CPS Control with Typed-Plan Firewalls
Threat_Attacker_Model: Untrusted or prompt-injected LLM planners proposing disallowed tools, unsafe control arguments, confused-deputy invocations, or jailbreak-style parameter payloads at the cyber-physical system (CPS) control boundary.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Deterministic execution-boundary mediator (Typed-Plan Firewall) normalizing planner output into a canonical Typed Intent Object (binding normalized tool ID, structured arguments, policy obligations, policy version, and replayable decision evidence) with fail-closed argument validation.
Enforcement_Point_Location: CPS Execution-Boundary Mediator (Typed-Plan Firewall Adapter) and Audit Denial-Trace Logger
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Fail-closed deterministic admission control and replayable denial-trace generation: achieves 25/25 conformance on typed-step cases, 100% blocking of injected unsafe steps across 60 supervisory CPS runs, and 2,275/2,275 expected outcomes for GPT-4.1 (2,155/2,275 for GPT-5.4) across canonical and stress suites (pp. 1–2, 8–9).
Trust_Assumptions: Platform assumption that all effectful CPS tools are reachable exclusively through the typed-plan firewall adapter (non-bypassability, Table 2 & Fig. 1 pp. 4, 7); physical plant dynamics and continuous control-loop stability proofs are out of scope.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 1, 8–9 (Section 6.3, Tables 7–8): across 3 supervisory CPS scenarios and 60 runs, records denial traces for 100% of injected unsafe steps while adding a mean run-level task p95 adapter latency of 36.70 ms (SD 22.07 ms, 95% CI [31.12, 42.29] ms, Table 8 p. 9).
Exposed_Security_Function: Typed intent normalization, policy-versioned structured argument validation, fail-closed gating, and replayable denial-trace emission
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Table 2 (p. 4) explicitly scopes out physical plant safety proofs, multi-step state invariant checking across turns, and OS/container platform hardening.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (25/25 conformance, 60 CPS runs, 36.70 ms mean run-level task p95 adapter latency, 2,275/2,275 on gpt-4.1); pp. 3–6 Sections 3–4 & Tables 1–5 (Threat model, scope Table 2, Typed-Plan Schema Table 4); pp. 7–9 Section 6 & Tables 6–8 (mean p95 latency 36.70 ms, SD 22.07 ms, 95% CI [31.12, 42.29] ms).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Typed-Plan Firewall menormalisasi keluaran perencana agen menjadi objek niat bertipe (mengikat ID alat, argumen terstruktur, versi kebijakan, dan bukti keputusan) untuk menegakkan validasi gagal-tertutup (fail-closed) dan jejak penolakan yang dapat diputar ulang pada batas kontrol CPS dengan rata-rata latensi adaptor p95 sebesar 36,70 ms (CI 95% [31,12; 42,29] ms).
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi pada 25 kasus langkah-bertipe, 60 run di 3 skenario CPS supervisi, perbandingan ablasi allow-list/schema-only, dan paket realisasi LLM 2.275 percobaan per model.
Protected_Object: Supervisory CPS actuator/configuration tools, structured control arguments, and replayable decision audit traces
Composition_Evidence: Mengikat keputusan admisi argumen terstruktur pada batas eksekusi alat (B3) dengan pembangkitan bukti penolakan terikat-versi kebijakan untuk audit/replay (B4).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (SaT-CPS'26) ini sangat teliti dalam mendefinisikan batas keamanan lokal (Table 2, p. 4) dan melaporkan latensi p95 36,70 ms ± 22,07 ms (Table 8, p. 9) pada batas B3;B4. Diberi kode AD karena jaminan bergantung pada asumsi non-bypassability platform dan tidak mencakup bukti stabilitas fisik CPS.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan latensi p95 36,70 ms pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: Security Analysis of Agentic AI Communication Protocols: A Comparative Evaluation
Threat_Attacker_Model: Network and multi-agent adversaries exploiting 14 vulnerability classes across authentication, authorization, message integrity, confidentiality, and availability in agent communication protocols (CORAL, ACP, and A2A).
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Comparative protocol security analysis and adversarial exploit evaluation across official CORAL implementation (SSE transport, Solana ledger audit trails), SDK-based ACP implementation (optional JWS RFC 7515 message signing, OAuth 2.0/JWT), and literature-evaluated Google A2A.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Inter-Agent Communication Protocol Gateways (CORAL SSE Gateway, ACP REST/JWS Handler, A2A AgentCard/OAuth Layer)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Systematically evaluates 14 protocol vulnerabilities across CORAL, ACP, and A2A: uncovers critical implementation-level auth/authz bypasses at CORAL's SSE gateway (100% reproducible exploit success, p. 45), high-impact integrity/confidentiality flaws in ACP due to optional JWS signature enforcement, and coarse token scope/lifetime weaknesses in A2A.
Trust_Assumptions: Evaluates protocol specifications vs concrete server/SDK implementations under active network/agent attackers within a controlled testbed.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 11–12, 36–46 (Tables 1–4): 14-point vulnerability taxonomy evaluated across CORAL, ACP, and A2A; empirical exploits against official CORAL server and ACP SDK achieve 100% reproducibility on unauthenticated SSE session hijacking, missing token expiration, and unsigned JWS message tampering (p. 45).
Exposed_Security_Function: JWS per-message digital signatures (ACP), OAuth 2.0 / JWT bearer tokens (A2A/ACP), and SSE session isolation / Solana ledger auditability (CORAL)
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Demonstrates a severe specification-to-implementation gap: CORAL's strong architectural session model fails at its unauthenticated SSE gateway, while ACP's optional JWS signatures leave messages exposed to tampering unless mandatory signing is enforced.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract (comparative security analysis of CORAL, ACP, and A2A across a 14-point vulnerability taxonomy); pp. 7–12 Section 4 & Table 1 / Figures 2–4 (A2A, CORAL, ACP architectures); pp. 12–36 Section 6 (14 vulnerabilities analysis); pp. 36–46 Sections 7–8 & Tables 2–4 (100% reproducible exploit validation & hybrid protocol recommendation).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Evaluasi keamanan komparatif pertama atas protokol komunikasi multi-agen CORAL, ACP, dan A2A menggunakan taksonomi 14-kerentanan mengungkap dikotomi tajam antara desain dan implementasi: CORAL rentan terhadap pembajakan sesi tanpa autentikasi pada gateway SSE (100% dapat direproduksi), ACP rentan terhadap pemalsuan pesan karena penandatanganan JWS bersifat opsional, dan A2A memiliki cakupan serta masa hidup token yang terlalu longgar.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi empiris pada implementasi resmi CORAL dan implementasi SDK ACP yang dibandingkan terhadap evaluasi literatur A2A di 14 dimensi kerentanan.
Protected_Object: Inter-agent communication messages (JWS), session tokens (JWT/SSE), and distributed multi-agent task state
Composition_Evidence: Menganalisis bagaimana kelemahan autentikasi/cakupan token saat delegasi (B2) dan ketiadaan tanda tangan per-pesan JWS wajib saat komunikasi/eksekusi (B3) merusak integritas alur kerja dan jejak audit (B4).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream M_AND_A (ACM TAISP'26, 54 hlm.) ini menguji langsung implementasi protokol komunikasi multi-agen (CORAL, ACP, A2A) pada batas B2;B3;B4. Diberi kode STAGE_0_PRE_QUANTUM_ONLY (JWS/JWT/TLS klasik) dan DG;AD karena ditemukannya celah implementasi fatal pada CORAL SSE dan opsionalitas tanda tangan JWS pada ACP. Juga didekomposisi menjadi klaim sekunder (CLM-E01-041B) untuk rekomendasi arsitektur hibrida wajib-JWS.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas matriks perbandingan 14 kerentanan pada CORAL, ACP, dan A2A.

Study_Title: Security Analysis of Agentic AI Communication Protocols: A Comparative Evaluation
Threat_Attacker_Model: Session hijacking, message tampering, token replay, and unauthorized cross-agent delegation exploiting the architectural/implementation dichotomy between CORAL, ACP, and A2A.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Hybrid multi-agent communication security architecture combining CORAL's session isolation, transport-layer validation, and Solana tamper-proof ledger auditability with ACP's mandatory per-message JWS (RFC 7515) cryptographic signatures and short-lived scoped tokens.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Hybrid Multi-Agent Protocol Gateway (Authenticated SSE Session Layer + Mandatory JWS Verifier + Ledger Audit Trail)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Addresses all 14 taxonomy vulnerabilities by enforcing mandatory cryptographic per-message integrity (JWS) atop authenticated session isolation and immutable ledger audit trails (Section 8, pp. 45–48).
Trust_Assumptions: Protocol gateways strictly reject unsigned JWS payloads and unauthenticated SSE connections; cryptographic signing keys are securely provisioned.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: Analytical synthesis and architectural recommendation derived from the 14-vulnerability comparative evaluation (Section 8, pp. 45–48); standalone benchmark overhead of the combined hybrid architecture in ms is NOT_REPORTED.
Exposed_Security_Function: Mandatory JWS per-message signing, authenticated SSE session isolation, and ledger-backed auditability
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Proposed hybrid protocol architecture is synthesized as a design recommendation in Section 8 rather than benchmarked as a unified software implementation (UG).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan lokasi. PDF p. 1 Abstract (hybrid approach combining CORAL's integrated architecture with ACP's mandatory per-message JWS integrity guarantees); pp. 45–48 Section 8 (Path Forward: Hybrid Protocol Recommendations & Table 4).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Merekomendasikan arsitektur protokol komunikasi agen hibrida yang memadukan isolasi sesi terintegrasi dan auditabilitas ledger CORAL dengan penegakan wajib tanda tangan kriptografis per-pesan JWS dari ACP untuk menutup 14 celah kerentanan yang teridentifikasi.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Sintesis arsitektural dan analisis komparatif berdasarkan pengujian empiris CORAL, ACP, dan A2A (Section 8, pp. 45–48).
Protected_Object: Multi-agent protocol sessions, JWS-signed inter-agent messages, and ledger audit trails
Composition_Evidence: Mengusulkan komposisi isolasi sesi tingkat transport (B2), tanda tangan JWS wajib per pesan (B3), dan pencatatan ledger tahan-manipulasi (B4).
Coding_Rationale: Dekomposisi Klaim Sekunder Reviewer 2 (CLM-E01-041B): Memisahkan usulan arsitektur protokol hibrida (CONCEPTUAL_ARCHITECTURE, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED) dari studi evaluasi empiris 14-kerentanan pada CORAL/ACP/A2A (CLM-E01-041).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas dekomposisi klaim arsitektur hibrida CLM-E01-041B.

Study_Title: TaintP2X: Detecting Taint-Style Prompt-to-Anything Injection Vulnerabilities in LLM-Integrated Applications
Threat_Attacker_Model: Prompt-to-Anything Injection (P2Xi) attacks where adversarial prompt inputs manipulate LLM outputs that flow unsanitized into security-sensitive application sinks, causing Remote Command Execution (RCE), SQL injection, file injection, or SSRF.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Hybrid static taint analysis and LLM-assisted semantic pruning framework (TaintP2X) modeling 49 LLM API output interfaces as taint sources, tracking inter-procedural data flow to sensitive sinks, and using LLM reasoning to identify custom sources and prune false positives.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Pre-Deployment Static Taint Analysis Pipeline for LLM-Integrated Application Source Code
Security_Property_Guaranteed: High-recall static detection of Prompt-to-Anything Injection (P2Xi) vulnerabilities: detects 27/35 benchmark vulnerabilities (77.1% recall vs 48.6% for LLMSmith and 20.0% for AgentFuzz, Table 2 pp. 7–8) and discovers 36 previously unknown vulnerabilities (26 confirmed by developers / CVE-assigned) across real-world open-source LLM apps.
Trust_Assumptions: Application source code is available for static CFG/data-flow analysis; LLM-assisted sanitizer/false-positive pruning accurately judges semantic reachability.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 1, 3, 7–10 (Section 4, Tables 2–4): on the 35-vulnerability benchmark, TaintP2X detects 27/35 vulnerabilities (77.1% recall), outperforming LLMSmith (17/35, 48.6%) and AgentFuzz (7/35, 20.0%), while LLM-assisted pruning improves detection precision/accuracy from 36.2% upwards and uncovers 36 zero-day P2Xi vulnerabilities in real-world projects.
Exposed_Security_Function: LLM-output taint source identification, inter-procedural sink propagation tracking, and LLM-assisted false-positive pruning (TaintP2X)
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Misses 8/35 benchmark vulnerabilities (77.1% recall, 22.9% false negative rate) due to complex dynamic dispatch or cross-language boundaries (DG), and relies on LLM judgment during false-positive pruning (AD).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 3 Section 1 (P2Xi vulnerability paradigm, TaintP2X 77.1% recall, 27/35 benchmark vulnerabilities detected vs 17 LLMSmith & 7 AgentFuzz); pp. 4–7 Section 3 & Figure 2 / Table 1 (49 predefined LLM API taint sources); pp. 7–10 Section 4 & Tables 2–4.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: TaintP2X memodelkan keluaran LLM sebagai sumber taint dan melacak perambatannya ke sink sensitif (RCE, SQLi, SSRF, injeksi berkas) dengan pemangkasan positif palsu berbantuan LLM, mencapai recall 77,1% (27/35 kerentanan) yang mengungguli LLMSmith dan AgentFuzz.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi pada benchmark 35 kerentanan P2Xi (dibandingkan dengan LLMSmith dan AgentFuzz) serta pemindaian aplikasi LLM sumber terbuka dunia nyata.
Protected_Object: Host command execution, SQL databases, filesystem paths, and network request sinks in LLM-integrated applications
Composition_Evidence: Melacak aliran data dari keluaran inferensi model hingga eksekusi fungsi sink sensitif pada batas integrasi aplikasi-alat (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (ICSE'26) ini mendefinisikan paradigma kerentanan Prompt-to-Anything Injection (P2Xi) pada batas B3 dan membuktikan peningkatan recall deteksi statis hingga 77,1% (DG;AD).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas perbandingan recall 77,1% vs LLMSmith/AgentFuzz (Table 2).

Study_Title: The Obvious Invisible Threat: Vulnerabilities of LLM-Powered GUI Agents to Adversarial UI Manipulations in Web Interaction Tasks
Threat_Attacker_Model: Web interface and user-generated content (UGC) adversaries deploying six UI attack types—Steal Private Information (SP), Denial of Service (DS), Unaligned Behavior (UB), Deceptive Defaults (DD), Manipulative Friction (MF), and novel Fine-Print Injection (FPI)—to induce unauthorized PII disclosure or misaligned actions in GUI agents.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Non-cryptographic factorial empirical vulnerability benchmark across 6 GUI agents, 6 attack types (including Fine-Print Injection FPI), 234 adversarial webpages (from 19 Mind2Web websites), a 39-participant human baseline, and a Phase 2 UGC FPI study.
Enforcement_Point_Location: GUI Agent Multimodal/DOM Perception Pipeline and Action Validation Interface
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Quantifies severe privacy/security vulnerability of GUI agents to subtly embedded UI attacks: Deceptive Defaults (DD) achieve near-100% ASR across foundation-model agents, Fine-Print Injection (FPI) achieves 66%–74% ASR on GPT-4o, Claude, and DeepSeek, and 97.4% of human baseline participants consent to malicious privacy policies (pp. 1, 3–4, 14–21).
Trust_Assumptions: GUI agent processes untrusted webpage DOM/visual content (including fine print and third-party UGC reviews/comments) while holding user-provided sensitive PII (SSN, driver's license, payment info) in context.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 1, 3–4, 10–21 (Tables 1–8): across 234 adversarial webpages (39 tasks x 6 attacks on 19 Mind2Web sites), 6 GUI agents, and 39 human participants, FPI achieves 66%–74% ASR on GPT-4o/Claude/DeepSeek, DD achieves ~100% ASR on most agents, and 97.4% of human participants fail to notice fine-print injections; Phase 2 confirms opportunistic UGC FPI efficacy (Table 8, p. 21).
Exposed_Security_Function: NOT_APPLICABLE — empirical study of 6 adversarial UI manipulations (including Fine-Print Injection) on GUI agents
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Demonstrates that perceptual flattening in GUI agents (giving equal semantic weight to low-salience fine print) and human habituation (97.4% policy consent) render both autonomous execution and naive human oversight highly vulnerable to Fine-Print Injection.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & pp. 3–4 Section 1 (6 GUI agents, 6 attack types including Fine-Print Injection FPI, 234 adversarial webpages, 39 human participants; FPI 66%–74% ASR; DD near 100% ASR; 97.4% human consent to malicious policies); pp. 8–13 Section 4 & Tables 1–4; pp. 14–21 Sections 5–6 & Table 8.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Mengevaluasi enam jenis manipulasi antarmuka adversarial—termasuk serangan baru Fine-Print Injection (FPI)—pada 6 agen GUI, 234 halaman web adversarial, dan 39 partisipan manusia, menunjukkan bahwa FPI mencapai ASR 66%–74%, Deceptive Defaults mencapai ASR mendekati 100%, dan 97,4% partisipan manusia menyetujui kebijakan privasi berbahaya.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Studi eksperimental faktorial pada 6 agen GUI dan 39 partisipan manusia di 234 halaman web adversarial (19 situs Mind2Web) serta eksperimen fase kedua pada konten buatan pengguna (UGC).
Protected_Object: Sensitive user PII (driver's license number, SSN, financial/health data) and GUI agent action alignment
Composition_Evidence: Menunjukkan bagaimana perataan persepsi saat agen membaca teks cetakan kecil/UGC (B1) memicu pengiriman informasi pribadi sensitif ke formulir atau tautan pihak ketiga yang berbahaya (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (ACM TAISP'26) ini memperkenalkan serangan Fine-Print Injection (FPI) dan membuktikan kegagalan sistematis agen GUI serta pengawasan manusia (97,4% gagal mendeteksi) pada batas B1;B3 (DG;AD).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas angka ASR FPI (66%–74%), DD (~100%), dan baseline manusia (97,4%).

Study_Title: The Verifier Tax: Horizon Dependent Safety--Success Tradeoffs in Tool Using LLM Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Multi-turn tool-using LLM agents bypassing mandatory procedural authentication steps by hallucinating or fabricating user identifiers ('Integrity Leaks') or failing to recover after runtime policy blocks in transactional Airline and Retail workflows.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Horizon-dependent runtime safety evaluation framework comparing Tool-Calling, planning-integrated (Triad), and policy-mediated (Triad-Safety) architectures across 15–30 turn horizons on tau-bench, plus proposed Strict Grounding Gates.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Runtime Policy Mediator (Triad-Safety Verifier) at the Multi-Turn Tool Invocation Boundary
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Uncovers the 'Safety-Capability Gap' and quantifies the 'Verifier Tax': while runtime safety mediation intercepts up to 94% of non-compliant actions, Safe Success Rate (SSR) remains <5% in most settings due to low post-block recovery (0%–21%) and ungrounded identifier hallucinations ('Integrity Leaks'), while inflating token cost by 2.0–2.8x (Tables 1–5, pp. 1–2, 5–8).
Trust_Assumptions: Evaluated runtime guardrails inspect proposed tool calls against policy rules but lack cryptographic or strict provenance binding to verify that user identifiers actually originated from authenticated user turns.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 1–2, 5–8 (Section 4, Tables 1–6): across Airline and Retail domains on tau-bench with GPT-OSS-20B and GLM-4-9B over horizons k in {5, 10, 15, 20, 30}, runtime safety mediation blocks up to 94% of non-compliant actions but achieves <5% Safe Success Rate (recovery rate 0%–21%) while imposing a 'Verifier Tax' of 2.0–2.8x token inflation (P95 token cost up to 355k tokens) and 1.6–2.2x call-count inflation (Table 5, p. 8).
Exposed_Security_Function: Runtime policy mediation (Triad-Safety) and proposed Strict Grounding Gates for user identifier provenance
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Directly quantifies how runtime policy verifiers induce 2.0–2.8x token overhead without achieving safe task completion (<5% SSR) when models hallucinate unauthenticated user IDs ('Integrity Leaks') or fail recovery reasoning.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (tau-bench Airline & Retail, 94% non-compliant action interception, SSR < 5%, Integrity Leaks via hallucinated user IDs, recovery rate 0%–21%, Verifier Tax 2.0–2.8x token inflation); pp. 5–8 Section 4 & Tables 1–6 (P95 token cost 355k tokens, 1.6–2.2x call inflation).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Mengungkap 'Safety-Capability Gap' dan 'Verifier Tax' pada agen pengguna-alat multi-putaran di tau-bench: meskipun mediasi keamanan runtime mencegat hingga 94% aksi tidak patuh, tingkat keberhasilan aman (SSR) tetap <5% akibat kebocoran integritas (halusinasi ID pengguna untuk melewati autentikasi) dan rendahnya pemulihan (0%–21%), sambil melipatgandakan biaya token sebesar 2,0–2,8x.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi tiga arsitektur agen (Tool-Calling, Triad, Triad-Safety) dengan GPT-OSS-20B dan GLM-4-9B pada domain Airline dan Retail tau-bench lintas horizon 5–30 putaran.
Protected_Object: Transactional tool invocations, mandatory user authentication steps, and user identifier integrity
Composition_Evidence: Membuktikan bahwa pencegatan per-langkah pada batas pemanggilan alat (B3) gagal menjamin keamanan alur kerja multi-putaran jika parameter identitas tidak diikat secara ketat ke input autentikasi pengguna.
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (CAIS'26) ini sangat krusial untuk RQ2 dan RQ3 karena mengkuantifikasi langsung 'Verifier Tax' (inflasi token 2,0–2,8x, P95 355k token pada Table 5) dan kebocoran integritas autentikasi multi-putaran (DG;AD).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT dan pencatatan 'Verifier Tax' (2,0–2,8x token overhead, Tabel 5) pada EVALUASI_EMPIRIS_OVERHEAD_RQ3.

Study_Title: Toward Agentic IAM: A Probabilistic Authorization Framework for Least Privilege AI Workflows
Threat_Attacker_Model: Privilege inflation, collusive multi-agent escalation, cognitive drift over long horizons, and state tampering in autonomous code-generation and cloud infrastructure orchestration workflows.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Sequential multi-agent probabilistic IAM framework (Analyze, Impact, Minimize, Validate, Reanalyze) combining Bayesian belief updates, Markov Decision Process (MDP) optimization, Integer Linear Programming (ILP) with Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) minimization, and Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) schedule enforcement.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Agentic IAM Sequential Authorization Orchestrator (Analyze -> Impact -> Minimize -> Validate -> Reanalyze)
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Formal proof sketches of resistance to privilege inflation, collusive escalation, cognitive drift, and state tampering (Properties 1–4 & Table 1, pp. 3–4), achieving 39%–46% privilege reduction (mean ~40%–43%) and 31%–39% risk score reduction with 100% service availability in an AWS Lambda maintenance case study (Table 2, p. 5).
Trust_Assumptions: Sequential transition schedule rho is enforced by an uncompromised orchestrator kernel; risk registry priors and Bayesian anomaly signals are calibrated; short-lived credentials/proof-of-possession tokens are enforced by the cloud provider.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF p. 1, 5 (Section 5, Table 2 & Figure 1): per-phase decision latencies are sub-second (Analyze 0.45 s, Impact 0.32 s, Minimize ILP <=80 permissions sub-second), converging to an enforceable policy in 1.3 s on average after the first iteration (1.85 s initial cold start) while reducing granted privileges by 39%–46% (43% mean) and risk by 31%–39% (35% mean).
Exposed_Security_Function: Bayesian/MDP/CVaR least-privilege optimization and sequential multi-agent authorization validation
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Security guarantees rely on accurate risk-registry priors and reward penalty weights in the MDP/CVaR formulation (AD), and empirical evaluation is limited to a single AWS Lambda patch maintenance case study (UG).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan audit langsung PDF ter-pin. PDF p. 1 Abstract (Bayesian belief, MDP, CVaR, sub-second phase latency, ~40% privilege reduction); pp. 2–3 Section 3 (Formal Model Eq. 1–7); pp. 3–4 Section 4 & Table 1 (Properties 1–4 & Proof Sketches); p. 5 Section 5, Table 2 & Figure 1 (39–46% privilege reduction, 31–39% risk reduction, 0.45s Analyze, 0.32s Impact, 1.3s average policy convergence).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Kerangka kerja Agentic IAM menggabungkan pembaruan kepercayaan Bayesian, optimisasi MDP, dan minimisasi CVaR dalam jadwal lima-agen sekuensial untuk menegakkan hak istimewa terkecil secara probabilistik, memangkas izin sebesar 39%–46% dan risiko sebesar 31%–39% dengan waktu konvergensi kebijakan rata-rata 1,3 detik (latensi per fase sub-detik).
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Diaudit ulang oleh Reviewer 2 dari PDF SCR-0419_ACM-S-0095.pdf (BDCAT'25, 6 hlm.): analisis keamanan formal (4 properti & sketsa bukti) serta studi kasus pemeliharaan AWS Lambda (Table 2, Figure 1).
Protected_Object: Cloud infrastructure IAM permissions (AWS Lambda/IAM roles) and dynamic agent workflow privileges
Composition_Evidence: Menyusun jadwal otorisasi sekuensial lima-fase (Analyze, Impact, Minimize, Validate, Reanalyze) pada batas delegasi dan negosiasi izin (B2).
Coding_Rationale: Audit & Penyempurnaan Reviewer 2 atas draf pilot CLM-0028: Meningkatkan Formal_Evidence_Type dari FORMAL_MODEL menjadi THEORETIC_PROOF karena Section 4 (pp. 3–4) menyajikan 4 Properti formal lengkap dengan Proof Sketch dan rumus LTL (Table 1). Memperkaya Performance_Overhead_Reported dengan rincian waktu per fase (Analyze 0,45 s, Impact 0,32 s, rata-rata konvergensi 1,3 s, cold start 1,85 s pada p. 5) dan kode limitasi AD;UG.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas peningkatan ke THEORETIC_PROOF dan rincian latensi Section 5 p. 5.

Study_Title: Towards Human-Centered Agent Authorization: A Landscape Analysis of Commercial AI Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Over-privileged commercial web-based AI agents and confused-deputy / prompt-injection exploits enabled by coarse OAuth permission bundling, lazy disconnect (persisting tokens after task completion), non-persistent scope disclosure, and reliance on probabilistic prompt guardrails rather than deterministic protocol restrictions.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Structured walkthrough and authorization landscape analysis across 18 commercial web-based AI agents (comparing Tool-based OAuth/API connector agents vs Web-Browsing credential/session delegation agents).
Enforcement_Point_Location: User-to-Agent OAuth/Session Authorization Interface and Post-Authorization Permission Management UI
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Identifies systemic authorization vulnerabilities across 18 commercial agents (Table 2, p. 7), exposing a dominant 'two-layer architecture' where broad deterministic system/OAuth permissions are masked by fragile, probabilistic LLM interface guardrails.
Trust_Assumptions: Users grant OAuth connectors or browser session access to commercial web agents assuming fine-grained, revocable, and task-scoped enforcement.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: Qualitative taxonomy and walkthrough audit of 18 commercial web-based AI agents across Transparency and Human Control dimensions (Tables 1–2, Figures 1–7, pp. 2–9); runtime latency overhead in ms is NOT_REPORTED.
Exposed_Security_Function: OAuth 2.0 scope negotiation, browser session delegation, and permission revocation interfaces (landscape audit)
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Demonstrates that commercial agents routinely request coarse read/write OAuth scopes or full browser cookies while relying on natural-language chat confirmations for high-risk actions, shifting security from deterministic access control to probabilistic model compliance.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan lokasi. PDF p. 1 Abstract (structured walkthroughs of 18 commercial web-based agents, bundled permissions, lazy disconnect, two-layer architecture shifting reliance from deterministic protocols to probabilistic model compliance); pp. 2–5 Sections 3–5 & Table 1; pp. 6–9 Appendix Table 2 & Figures 1–7.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Analisis lanskap terhadap 18 agen AI berbasis web komersial mengungkap pola otorisasi bermasalah yang meluas (penggabungan izin kasar, pemutusan malas/lazy disconnect, pengungkapan non-persisten) serta arsitektur dua-lapis yang menuntut izin sistem luas namun mengandalkan kepatuhan model yang probabilistik sebagai penjaga antarmuka.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Evaluasi walkthrough terstruktur pada 18 agen AI komersial berbasis web (termasuk Manus, Operator, Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Zapier, dll. pada Tabel 2).
Protected_Object: User OAuth 2.0 tokens, third-party cloud/workspace accounts, and authenticated browser sessions
Composition_Evidence: Mengungkap ketidakselarasan struktural antara negosiasi izin pengguna di antarmuka (B1) dan cakupan token OAuth/sesi jangka panjang yang didelegasikan ke konektor alat agen (B2).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (CHI EA'26) ini mengaudit langsung 18 agen komersial yang dideploy (DEPLOYMENT_LIKE_EVALUATION) dan membuktikan pergeseran berbahaya dari protokol deterministik ke kepatuhan model probabilistik pada batas B1;B2 (DG;AD).
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas temuan arsitektur dua-lapis pada 18 agen komersial.

Study_Title: Towards Practically-Secure Tools for AI Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Untrusted, buggy, or malicious third-party MCP tool servers performing undeclared filesystem mutations, arbitrary network exfiltration, or cross-tool side effects that diverge from their natural-language tool documentation.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Hybrid static-dynamic tool protection framework combining automated static code analysis of tool implementations (extracting coarse-grained effect synopses and verifying correct sandbox API usage) with dynamic fine-grained sandboxes and client-side policy enforcement.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Trusted Client-Side Policy Enforcement Layer and Tool-Server Fine-Grained Runtime Sandbox
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Enforces least-authority tool execution: static analysis guarantees all possible tool effects are either captured in the synopsis or mediated by fine-grained sandboxes, and only the hybrid setup correctly allows benign variants while blocking both coarse and fine-grained malicious tool variants across 4 scenario families (Table 1, pp. 6–7).
Trust_Assumptions: Client-side interpreter and policy enforcement layer are trusted; tool source code is available for static analysis prior to execution; binary patches to compiled executables are out of scope (Section 2.2, p. 3).
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 6–7 (Section 5 & Table 1): qualitative evaluation across 4 protection setups (No Protection, Coarse Sandbox, Fine Sandbox Only, Hybrid) and 3 tool-code variants (Benign, Malicious-Coarse, Malicious-Fine) on a real MCP tool server shows only the Hybrid approach blocks both malicious variants while preserving benign utility; numerical latency overhead in ms is NOT_REPORTED (calibrated from pilot template).
Exposed_Security_Function: Static tool-effect synopsis extraction, sandbox-usage verification, and client-side hybrid policy enforcement
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Preliminary workshop prototype evaluated qualitatively on representative scenario variants (Table 1, p. 6) without quantitative latency/throughput benchmarks over full MCPToolBench (UG); requires access to analyzable tool source code and excludes compiled binary patches (p. 3, AD).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan audit langsung PDF ter-pin. PDF p. 1 Abstract (hybrid automated code analysis + dynamic fine-grained sandboxes); pp. 3–5 Section 3 & Figure 2 (Effect synopses, fine-grained sandboxes, trusted client enforcement); pp. 6–7 Section 5 & Table 1 (Qualitative comparison across 4 setups and 3 scenario variants).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Menggabungkan analisis kode statis otomatis (untuk menghasilkan sinopsis efek alat dan memverifikasi penempatan sandbox) dengan sandbox dinamis berbutir halus dan penegakan kebijakan di sisi klien guna mencegah efek samping alat pihak ketiga yang tidak sah.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Diaudit ulang oleh Reviewer 2 dari PDF SCR-0422_ACM-S-0099.pdf (EuroMLSys'26, 10 hlm.): evaluasi kualitatif purwarupa pada 4 konfigurasi mekanisme proteksi dan 3 varian skenario (Table 1, pp. 6–7).
Protected_Object: Host filesystem, network access, and user data exposed to third-party MCP tool servers
Composition_Evidence: Mengomposisikan verifikasi analisis statis atas kode alat dengan penegakan kebijakan runtime di klien dan sandbox berbutir halus pada batas pemanggilan alat (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Audit & Penyempurnaan Reviewer 2 atas draf pilot CLM-0029: Pemeriksaan langsung PDF p. 6–7 menunjukkan bahwa evaluasi pada Section 5 (Table 1) bersifat kualitatif (Allowed vs Blocked pada 3 varian skenario) dan belum melaporkan angka latensi/overhead numerik pada MCPToolBench (MCPToolBench hanya disebut di bagian referensi/rencana). Oleh karena itu, Implementation_Maturity dikalibrasi menjadi PROOF_OF_CONCEPT, Performance_Overhead_Reported dikoreksi sesuai Table 1, dan kode limitasi diperbarui menjadi AD;UG.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas kalibrasi PROOF_OF_CONCEPT dan koreksi deskripsi evaluasi kualitatif Table 1.

Study_Title: Towards Verifiably Safe Tool Use for LLM Agents
Threat_Attacker_Model: Unintended or prompt-injected tool interactions leaking confidential enterprise data or overwriting critical records across multi-step tool sequences, even in the absence of an explicit attacker.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: System-Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA) hazard derivation combined with a capability-enhanced Model Context Protocol (MCP) enforcing structured information-flow labels (capabilities, confidentiality, trust level) and temporal tool-sequence specifications.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Capability-Enhanced MCP Reference Monitor enforcing Information Flow Control (IFC) and Temporal Constraints
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Vision and formal specification methodology for verifiably safe tool use: binds STPA-derived safety requirements to enforceable IFC data-flow and temporal tool-ordering specifications over labeled MCP tools.
Trust_Assumptions: MCP tool metadata labels (capability, confidentiality, trust level) are accurately assigned (via LLM-assisted labeling + human/enterprise audit) and enforced by an unbypassable MCP reference monitor.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: 5-page ICSE-NIER vision/preliminary paper presenting motivating examples and preliminary STPA/MCP label design (Sections 4–5, pp. 2–4); quantitative runtime overhead in ms is NOT_REPORTED.
Exposed_Security_Function: STPA hazard-to-specification derivation and capability/confidentiality/trust-labeled MCP information flow control
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: 5-page NIER vision paper without a completed end-to-end empirical benchmark evaluation (UG); relies on accurate acquisition and validation of structured confidentiality/trust labels across heterogeneous external data sources (Section 4.3, p. 4, AD).
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan lokasi. PDF p. 1 Abstract & Figure 1 (STPA hazard analysis, IFC + temporal constraints, capability-enhanced MCP with capabilities, confidentiality, and trust-level labels); pp. 2–4 Section 4 (Identifying Agent Requirements, Defining/Enforcing Specifications, Acquiring Structured Labels); p. 4 Sections 5–6 (Preliminary Results & Future Plans).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Mengusulkan metodologi berbasis System-Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA) dan kerangka kerja MCP yang diperkaya label terstruktur (kapabilitas, kerahasiaan, dan tingkat kepercayaan) untuk memformalkan serta menegakkan spesifikasi aliran informasi (IFC) dan urutan temporal pemanggilan alat secara terverifikasi.

Study_Title: TrustOrch: A Dynamic Trust-Aware Orchestration Framework for Adversarially Robust Multi-Agent Collaboration
Threat_Attacker_Model: Byzantine/compromised agents, prompt injection propagation, action perturbation, and sybil/collusion attacks in distributed multi-agent collaboration.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Dynamic trust-aware orchestration framework (TrustOrch) combining multi-dimensional real-time trust scoring, RL + game-theoretic adversary-aware orchestration, adaptive topology reconfiguration, explainable decision tracing, and blockchain Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) with Proof-of-Cooperation (PoC) consensus.
Enforcement_Point_Location: Multi-Agent Orchestration Layer and Blockchain-Based DID/Trust Verification Layer
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Achieves 91.7% task robustness under adversarial multi-agent attacks, 95.9% precision and 94.0% recall in malicious agent detection (Table 2, p. 5), 62% collision rate reduction, and 39.8% communication overhead reduction (Table 1 & Figures 2–3, pp. 4–5).
Trust_Assumptions: Majority of cooperating agents in the Proof-of-Cooperation blockchain layer remain honest; behavioral consistency and decision accuracy signals are observable by the orchestrator.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 1, 4–6 (Section 5, Tables 1–2, Figures 2–3): evaluated across 3 multi-agent benchmark scenarios; achieves 91.7% adversarial robustness (maintaining >85% success under high-intensity attacks), 95.9% precision / 94.0% recall (94.2% F1/accuracy) in malicious agent detection, 62% collision reduction, and 39.8% reduction in message communication overhead.
Exposed_Security_Function: Dynamic multi-dimensional trust scoring, adaptive topology pruning, and blockchain DID / Proof-of-Cooperation verification
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Blockchain DID and Proof-of-Cooperation layer relies on classical cryptography while explicitly identifying integration of quantum-resistant cryptographic primitives as future work (Section 6, p. 6); evaluated in simulated multi-agent environments without formal Byzantine fault bounds.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan audit langsung PDF ter-pin. PDF p. 1 Abstract (62% collision reduction, 91.7% adversarial robustness, 39.8% communication overhead reduction); pp. 2–4 Sections 3–4 & Figure 1 (TrustOrch architecture, Blockchain DIDs & Proof-of-Cooperation); pp. 4–5 Section 5, Tables 1–2 & Figures 2–3 (95.9% precision, 94.0% recall); p. 6 Section 6 (quantum-resistant cryptographic primitives future direction).
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: TrustOrch mengintegrasikan penilaian kepercayaan dinamis multi-dimensi, orkestrasi sadar-lawan berbasis RL/teori permainan, topologi kolaborasi adaptif, dan verifikasi identitas terdesentralisasi (DID) berbasis blockchain, mencapai ketahanan 91,7% terhadap serangan adversarial serta memangkas overhead komunikasi sebesar 39,8%.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Diaudit ulang oleh Reviewer 2 dari PDF SCR-0424_ACM-S-0102.pdf (AISNS'25, 7 hlm.): evaluasi pada 3 skenario benchmark multi-agen (mengemudi otonom, respons bencana, kolaborasi finansial) terhadap serangan injeksi prompt dan perturbasi aksi.
Protected_Object: Multi-agent decentralized identities (DIDs), inter-agent collaboration topology, and decision audit chains
Composition_Evidence: Mengomposisikan verifikasi DID dan skor kepercayaan saat orkestrasi/delegasi (B2), isolasi agen berbahaya dari eksekusi kolaboratif (B3), dan pencatatan rantai audit keputusan di blockchain (B4).
Coding_Rationale: Audit & Penyempurnaan Reviewer 2 atas draf pilot CLM-0030: Mengubah Target_Boundary menjadi MULTI_BOUNDARY (selaras dengan `B2;B3;B4`), memverifikasi kutipan PQC pada p. 6 ('integration of quantum-resistant cryptographic primitives', STAGE_1_SUGGESTED_MIGRATION), dan menambahkan klaim dekomposisi sekunder (CLM-0030B) untuk mekanisme DID/Proof-of-Cooperation dan rantai audit B4.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Konfirmasi Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas pemetaan MULTI_BOUNDARY (B2;B3;B4) dan dekomposisi klaim TrustOrch.

Study_Title: Understanding Bugs in Model Context Protocol Development Frameworks: An Empirical Study
Threat_Attacker_Model: Framework-level software bugs in core MCP SDKs (FastMCP, Go SDK, Python SDK, TypeScript SDK)—including critical OAuth token refresh flaws, authentication/authorization defects, and transport/negotiation failures—that propagate to downstream MCP servers and agent applications.
Cryptographic_Primitive_or_Mechanism: Large-scale empirical taxonomy of 535 resolved MCP framework bugs (symptoms, root causes, fix patterns) and evaluation of LLM-based Automated Program Repair (APR) augmented with MCP specification retrieval.
Enforcement_Point_Location: MCP SDK Framework Layer (FastMCP, Go SDK, Python SDK, TypeScript SDK) and OAuth/Transport Negotiation Handlers
Security_Property_Guaranteed: Characterizes 535 resolved bugs across 4 foundational MCP SDKs: reveals that negotiation failures (32.5%), execution errors (26.2%), and deployment failures (18.5%) dominate symptoms, while framework implementation defects (48.4%), protocol/spec violations (14.4%), and authentication/authorization defects (11.6%, e.g., FastMCP OAuth token refresh bug #1649 affecting ~50% of MCP Proxy Servers, Fig. 1 p. 3) dominate root causes; specification-guided LLM repair resolves up to 81.3% of bugs complementarity (69.5% best single config).
Trust_Assumptions: Downstream MCP servers and agent hosts rely on official MCP SDKs to faithfully enforce OAuth 2.0 token lifecycles, session isolation, and JSON-RPC/SSE transport specifications.
Performance_Overhead_Reported: PDF pp. 1–3, 14–38 (Sections 5.1–5.4, Tables 2–10): analyzed 535 resolved bugs across FastMCP (311), Go SDK (86), Python SDK (72), and TypeScript SDK (66); auth/authz defects account for 11.6% of root causes; complementary LLM repair configurations resolve 81.3% of evaluated bugs (single best config 69.5% vs 45.1% baseline).
Exposed_Security_Function: MCP SDK OAuth token lifecycle management, session/transport negotiation, and specification-guided automated bug repair
Residual_Gap_and_Limitations: Shows that 11.6% of MCP SDK bugs are authentication/authorization defects and 14.4% are protocol specification violations at the framework layer, silently undermining security guarantees of downstream MCP deployments.
Evidence_Quote_and_Page: PARAFRASA dan kutipan metrik terukur. PDF p. 1 Abstract & p. 2 Section 1 (535 resolved bugs across FastMCP 311, Go SDK 86, Python SDK 72, TS SDK 66; symptoms: negotiation 32.5%, execution 26.2%, deployment 18.5%; root causes: implementation 48.4%, protocol/spec 14.4%, auth/authz 11.6%; APR resolves up to 69.5% / 81.3% combined); p. 3 Figure 1 (FastMCP OAuth token refresh bug #1649 affecting ~50% of MCP Proxy Servers); pp. 14–38 Section 5.
Claim_Text_As_Reported: Parafrasa penulis: Studi empiris atas 535 bug yang diselesaikan pada empat kerangka kerja pengembangan MCP utama (FastMCP, Go SDK, Python SDK, TypeScript SDK) mengungkap bahwa kegagalan negosiasi (32,5%) dan kesalahan eksekusi (26,2%) merupakan gejala dominan, sementara cacat implementasi (48,4%), pelanggaran spesifikasi protokol (14,4%), serta cacat autentikasi/otorisasi (11,6%, termasuk bug penyegaran token OAuth #1649) merupakan akar masalah utama.
Assessed_Claim_Scope: Analisis taksonomi manual atas 535 bug nyata dari 4 SDK MCP utama serta evaluasi perbaikan program otomatis berbasis LLM (APR).
Protected_Object: MCP SDK transport sessions, OAuth 2.0 access/refresh tokens, and tool invocation execution reliability
Composition_Evidence: Membuktikan bahwa cacat tingkat SDK pada negosiasi sesi/token OAuth (B2) merambat menjadi kegagalan autentikasi dan eksekusi alat di seluruh aplikasi hilir (B3).
Coding_Rationale: Ekstraksi Reviewer 2: Studi Stream A (TOSEM'26, 49 hlm.) ini memberikan bukti empiris tingkat kerangka kerja atas cacat OAuth/protokol pada SDK MCP (B2;B3) dengan kode limitasi DG;AD.
Required_Additional_Evidence: Verifikasi silang Reviewer 1 pada REVIEW_AUDIT atas distribusi gejala dan akar masalah 535 bug SDK MCP.
